📄 Complete Details & Notification

The Union Public Service Commission (UPSC) has declared the written result of the Combined Defence Services Examination (II), 2026 on 19 October 2026. The examination was held on 13 September 2026 for 451 vacancies in the Indian Military Academy (IMA), Indian Naval Academy (INA), Air Force Academy (AFA) and Officers Training Academy (OTA). Candidates whose roll numbers appear in the result PDF at upsc.gov.in qualify for the next stage, the SSB interview.

  • Who declared it: Union Public Service Commission (UPSC)
  • Exam: Combined Defence Services Examination (II), 2026 (Advt No. 11/2026-CDS-II)
  • Result status: Declared on 19 October 2026
  • Result format: PDF on the official UPSC website
  • Next stage: SSB interview (Stage I and Stage II)

Particulars Details
Conducting Body Union Public Service Commission (UPSC)

UPSC CDS 2 Result 2026 PDF Download

The written result is available as a PDF on the UPSC website. Open the PDF and search for your roll number to confirm whether you have qualified for the SSB interview. No login is needed to open the result PDF.

Direct official link: Download UPSC CDS 2 Written Result PDF

How to Check UPSC CDS 2 Result 2026

  1. Visit the official UPSC website at upsc.gov.in.
  2. Open the What's New section or the Written Results section.
  3. Click the link for the written result of Combined Defence Services Examination (II), 2026.
  4. The result PDF opens on the screen.
  5. Press Ctrl + F and search your roll number.
  6. Download and save the PDF, and take a printout for future reference.

How to Check ISRO Assistant & JPA Result 2026?

  1. Visit the official ISRO website at isro.gov.in.
  2. Open the Careers or Current Opportunities section.

Details Mentioned in ISRO ICRB Result 2026 PDF

The official shortlisted-candidate PDFs contain the following details:

ISRO Assistant & Junior Personal Assistant Skill Test 2026

Candidates shortlisted through the Computer Based Test will be required to appear for the next selection stage. ISRO has scheduled the Skill Test for 1 November 2026.

The Document Verification schedule, reporting time and venue are provided in the respective zone-wise result PDFs. Candidates should carefully read the instructions applicable to their post and recruitment zone.

For example, the Ahmedabad Assistant result PDF specifies Document Verification on 31 October 2026 at 9:30 AM and the Skill Test on 1 November 2026. The dates and reporting arrangements should not be assumed to be identical for every zone.

What Happens After ISRO Assistant & JPA Result 2026?

The published CBT result identifies candidates shortlisted for the Skill Test. Shortlisting does not mean final selection.

Candidates should check their respective result PDF for the next-stage schedule and keep the required documents ready according to ISRO instructions. Further recruitment updates will be published through the official website.

The Karnataka Examinations Authority (KEA) has released the KSET Result 2026 as a provisional score list on 26 October 2026 at 10:30 AM. The Karnataka State Eligibility Test (KSET) was held on 11 October 2026 across 37 subjects and decides eligibility for Assistant Professor posts in universities and colleges in Karnataka. Candidates can check their provisional marks on the official KEA result portal. The final qualified list, subject-wise cut off and eligibility certificate details are Not Yet Announced.

KSET Result 2026 Download Link

The KSET 2026 provisional score list is available on the official KEA recruitment result page. Candidates should use only the official KEA links given below.

  • Direct Link to Check KEA KSET Result 2026
  • KEA Official Website: cetonline.karnataka.gov.in/kea

How to Check KSET Result 2026

Follow these steps to view your provisional marks online.

  1. Open the official KEA website at cetonline.karnataka.gov.in/kea.
  2. Go to the latest KSET 2026 updates on the homepage.
  3. Click the KSET 2026 provisional score list or result link. You can also open the direct result page given above.
  4. Enter the login details asked on the result page. These are typically the application number and date of birth.
  5. Submit the details and check your paper-wise marks and other information on the screen.
  6. Download or print the score details and keep a copy until the final result is published.

Details Mentioned in the KSET Result 2026

Check every detail in your score list carefully. Depending on the result page, the following information may be shown.

  • Candidate name
  • Application number or roll number
  • Subject name
  • Paper-wise marks (Paper I and Paper II)
  • Total marks
  • Category information

Also Read: RRB Section Controller Answer Key 2026

KSET 2026 Revised Answer Key

KEA released the provisional answer keys for Paper I and Paper II on 12 October 2026 and accepted objections until 14 October 2026 at 10:30 AM. After reviewing the objections, KEA published the revised answer keys on 23 October 2026. The score list was prepared after this review. The revised answer keys are available on the official KEA website.

KSET 2026 Category Details for SCA, SCB and SCC Candidates

KEA issued a separate notice on 23 October 2026 for candidates belonging to the SCA, SCB and SCC categories. These candidates have to submit their category details online through the official KEA recruitment portal. The submission facility opens on 28 October 2026 at 10:00 AM. The last date for submission is Not Available Officially. This is a category-information process and is not a chance to challenge exam marks.

KSET Score List Objection

KEA's notice dated 24 October 2026 includes an online form for objections to the score list. At the time of writing, the form is not accepting responses. Candidates should keep checking the official KEA website for any revised instructions about raising objections.

KSET 2026 Qualifying Marks

The Karnataka SET follows the standard State Eligibility Test framework for minimum aggregate marks across Paper I and Paper II.

Category Minimum Aggregate Marks
General / Unreserved 40%
Reserved Categories (SC, ST, OBC, PwD) 35%

KSET 2026 Exam Pattern

The KSET 2026 exam was conducted in OMR mode on 11 October 2026 from 10 AM to 1 PM. It has two objective papers, as shown below.

Paper Content Questions Marks
Paper I Teaching and Research Aptitude (common for all subjects) 50 100
Paper II Subject chosen by the candidate (37 subjects) 100 200

Selection Process and What After the KSET Result

KSET is an eligibility test, not a direct recruitment exam. The process is as follows.

  1. Written exam: Paper I and Paper II (completed on 11 October 2026).
  2. Provisional score list (released on 26 October 2026).
  3. Final qualified list from KEA (Not Yet Announced).
  4. Eligibility certificate for qualified candidates, which makes them eligible to apply for Assistant Professor posts in Karnataka universities and colleges.

Documents to Keep Ready (Indicative)

KEA has not published an official post-result document checklist yet. The documents below are commonly needed for certificate verification and are given only as a guide. Follow the official notice when it is released.

  • KSET 2026 score list printout and application form copy
  • Date of birth proof, such as the Class 10 certificate
  • Government photo ID
  • Master's degree pass certificate and mark sheets
  • Valid category or PwD certificate, if applicable
  • Recent passport size photographs

Why Did SSC Release the GD Constable Revised Result 2026?

SSC received representations from candidates seeking clarification about the categories shown in the original PET/PST shortlists.

Some applicants had applied under SC, ST, OBC, EWS or Ex-Servicemen categories but qualified the Computer-Based Examination using the standards prescribed for Unreserved candidates.

As a result, these candidates appeared under the Unreserved category in the earlier lists.

To make the information clearer, SSC published detailed lists containing both the candidates' original application categories and their categories considered for shortlisting.

The principal purpose of the updated lists is to make the category information clearer.

Candidates must continue to follow the original PET/PST shortlisting requirements and subsequent examination instructions.

SSC GD PET/PST Date 2026

Candidates provisionally shortlisted through the SSC GD Computer-Based Examination will proceed to the Physical Efficiency Test and Physical Standard Test.

The 23 October revised-result notice does not specify the PET/PST date, test centre or reporting schedule.

Candidates should check the relevant official recruitment announcements for the physical examination schedule and admit-card instructions.

SSC GD Selection Process 2026

The SSC GD Constable recruitment process includes the following stages:

  1. Computer-Based Examination: Candidates are assessed through the prescribed online examination.
  2. Physical Efficiency Test: Provisionally shortlisted candidates must meet the applicable physical efficiency requirements.
  3. Physical Standard Test: Candidates undergo the prescribed physical measurement checks.
  4. Detailed Medical Examination: Eligible candidates undergo medical evaluation under the applicable recruitment rules.
  5. Document Verification and Final Selection: Candidates must fulfil the remaining recruitment and eligibility conditions.

Appearing in the revised CBE shortlist does not guarantee final selection or appointment.

How to Check GPSSB Talati Cum Mantri Final Result 2026?

  1. Visit the official Gujarat Panchayat Service Selection Board website at gpssb.gujarat.gov.in.
  2. Open the Results or Latest Updates section.
  3. Look for Advertisement No. 14/2025-26.
  4. Select Village Panchayat Secretary (Talati Cum Mantri), Special Recruitment Drive for PwBD.
  5. Find the Final Select List & Recommendation cum District Allotment List dated 22 October 2026.
  6. Open the official PDF.
  7. Use the search function to find your examination seat number or confirmation number.
  8. Check your final merit number, category and marks.
  9. Verify the district allotted and any remarks.
  10. Save the PDF and follow subsequent appointment instructions.

GPSSB Talati Final Result 2026 – Document Verification

According to the official result instructions, the relevant appointing authority must verify candidates' original documents and eligibility before issuing appointment orders.

Verification may include:

  • Educational qualification certificates
  • Proof of age
  • Applicable caste or reservation certificates
  • PwBD certificates and their validity
  • Computer knowledge certificate
  • Sports or other supporting certificates, where applicable
  • No Objection Certificate for candidates already employed in government service, where required
  • Other original documents prescribed under the recruitment rules

Applicable category certificates must also undergo verification by the competent authority before appointment.

GPSSB Talati Final Result 2026 – Biometric Verification

The official notice requires biometric verification of recommended candidates at the relevant District Panchayat.

This process is intended to establish that the candidate who appeared in the examination is the same person recommended by the Board.

Appointment-related procedures can proceed only after completion of the prescribed verification and eligibility checks.

Does GPSSB Talati District Allotment Guarantee Appointment?

No. GPSSB explicitly states that inclusion in the Final Select List and Recommendation cum District Allotment List does not create an automatic right to appointment.

The appointing authority must verify the required documents, eligibility conditions, biometric identity and other applicable requirements.

Candidates whose recommendations remain pending must wait for the Board's further decision.

What Happens After GPSSB Talati Final Result 2026?

Candidates with district allotments should follow instructions from the concerned District Panchayat or appointing authority.

The next process includes verification of original certificates, applicable category certificate checks, biometric verification and other appointment formalities.

Candidates already serving in government employment may be required to produce a No Objection Certificate from their existing employer.

Appointment orders will be issued only after the competent authority is satisfied that the prescribed conditions have been fulfilled.

The recruitment is being conducted for 60 vacancies across General, DEPR and DSIM cadres, of which 40 belong to the General Cadre. Check the result PDF, cadre-wise status, important dates and selection details below.

How to Download RBI Officer Grade B Final Result 2026?

Candidates can download the RBI Grade B General Cadre final merit list from the official RBI recruitment portal by following these steps.

  1. Visit the official RBI Opportunities website at opportunities.rbi.org.in.
  2. Open the Current Vacancies section.
  3. Select the Results section.
  4. Find the final result for Officers in Grade B (DR) - General Cadre, Panel Year 2026.
  5. Open the final result notification.
  6. Download the official roll-number-wise result PDF.
  7. Press Ctrl + F on your computer or use the PDF search option on your mobile device.
  8. Enter your examination roll number.
  9. If your roll number appears, read the accompanying notice for further instructions.
  10. Save the result PDF for future reference.

RBI Grade B General Final Result 2026

The RBI Grade B General Cadre Final Result 2026 was declared on 15 October 2026. This recruitment stream has 40 notified vacancies.

RBI has published a roll-number-wise result PDF containing candidates recommended for selection. Candidates should check their roll numbers carefully and follow the instructions in the official result notice.

General Cadre Final Result: Download Official Selection List PDF.

RBI Grade B DEPR and DSIM Final Result 2026

The RBI Grade B recruitment also includes 10 vacancies in the DEPR Cadre and 10 vacancies in the DSIM Cadre.

The final result release confirmed on 15 October 2026 relates to the General Cadre. Candidates awaiting DEPR and DSIM final results should monitor the official RBI recruitment website for their respective selection lists.

Candidates should not confuse the earlier Phase-I or Phase-II results with the final selection results.

RBI Grade B Final Merit List 2026

The RBI Grade B final selection process includes the Phase-II examination and interview. The final merit list is prepared according to the applicable RBI recruitment rules and performance in the prescribed selection stages.

The official result PDF provides the roll numbers of recommended candidates. Inclusion in the result list is subject to the terms, conditions and verification requirements specified by RBI.

What Details Are Available in RBI Grade B Final Result 2026?

Candidates can use the official final result notice and PDF to check the following information:

  • Recruitment name and panel year
  • General Cadre final selection status
  • Roll numbers of recommended candidates
  • Official instructions for selected candidates

Candidates should rely on the official RBI documents for all appointment-related instructions.

What Happens After RBI Grade B Final Result 2026?

Candidates whose roll numbers appear in the final selection list should read the accompanying RBI result notice carefully. Subsequent formalities will be governed by the bank's applicable recruitment and appointment conditions.

Candidates should keep their original educational, identity and category certificates ready as required and follow official communications from RBI.

Candidates can download the official result PDF from sbi.bank.in and search their roll numbers to check whether they have qualified for Phase 3. The Psychometric Test is tentatively scheduled for 31 October 2026, followed by Group Exercises and Interviews from 18 November 2026 onwards. Check the direct result link, shortlisted candidates list and next selection schedule below.

How to Download SBI PO Mains Result 2026 PDF?

Candidates can check the SBI PO Mains Result 2026 through the official Careers section. No login credentials are required to download the publicly available result PDF.

  1. Visit the official SBI Careers website at sbi.bank.in/web/careers/current-openings.
  2. Find "Recruitment of Probationary Officers" under Advertisement No. CRPD/PO/2026-27/09.
  3. Click the "Main Examination Result" link.
  4. The official result PDF will open.
  5. Press Ctrl + F on a computer or use the search function in a mobile PDF viewer.
  6. Enter your complete examination roll number.
  7. If your roll number appears in the PDF, you have been shortlisted for Phase 3.
  8. Download and save the result PDF for future reference.

Important: The PDF contains shortlisted roll numbers. Candidates should use their Mains examination roll number when checking the list.

SBI PO Mains Merit List 2026: How to Check Your Roll Number?

The SBI PO Mains Merit List 2026 is available as a three-page PDF containing the roll numbers of candidates shortlisted for the next stage. The PDF does not require individual candidate login.

  • Download the official SBI PO Mains result PDF.
  • Open the PDF using a browser or PDF reader.
  • Use the search option to enter your complete roll number.
  • Check whether the roll number appears in the list.
  • Preserve the result PDF and monitor further Phase 3 announcements.

The published list confirms shortlisting for Phase 3 and does not represent final appointment or selection as a Probationary Officer.

What Details Are Mentioned in SBI PO Mains Result 2026?

The official SBI PO Mains result PDF provides information about the examination and candidates shortlisted for the next selection stage.

  • Name of the recruiting organisation

  • Roll numbers of shortlisted candidates
  • Next selection stage

SBI PO Mains Result 2026: What Is the Next Selection Stage?

Candidates shortlisted through the SBI PO Mains examination will proceed to Phase 3, consisting of a Psychometric Test, Group Exercise and Interview. SBI has published the tentative dates for these stages.

Selection Stage Schedule
Psychometric Test 31 October 2026
Group Exercise From 18 November 2026
Interview From 18 November 2026
Exact Date, Time and Venue To Be Mentioned in Call Letter

The dates are tentative. SBI has stated that individual call letters containing the exact schedule will be released separately.

SBI PO Phase 3 Call Letter 2026 and Interview Schedule

The SBI PO Phase 3 call letters will be issued separately for shortlisted candidates. The official notice schedules the Psychometric Test for 31 October 2026 and Group Exercises and Interviews from 18 November 2026 onwards.

Candidates should regularly check the official SBI Careers page and their registered communication channels for the exact date, time and venue. The bank has stated that shortlisted candidates will be informed through SMS or email.

SBI PO Mains Scorecard 2026 and Cut Off Marks

The SBI PO Mains Result 2026 has been released in the form of a roll-number shortlist. The official result PDF does not provide individual marks, section-wise scores or category-wise cut-off marks.

Candidates should check the SBI Careers website for a separate announcement regarding the Mains scorecard and cut-off marks. No exact scorecard release date is specified in the published result PDF.

What If Your Roll Number Is Not in SBI PO Mains Result 2026?

If your roll number is not found in the SBI PO Mains result PDF, first make sure you have checked the correct examination result and entered your complete roll number.

  • Confirm that the PDF is for Advertisement No. CRPD/PO/2026-27/09.
  • Use the roll number from your Mains admit card.
  • Check every digit of your roll number.
  • Try the PDF search option or inspect the list manually.
  • Check the official website for further result-related instructions.

The published shortlist does not provide individual marks or explain the reason for non-shortlisting.

SBI SO Law Officer Selection Process

The selection process has two stages.

  1. Online Written Test: The merit list for this stage is prepared on the combined score of the objective test and the descriptive test. The descriptive test carries 50 marks, with 5 questions to be answered out of 8 in 45 minutes.
  2. Interview: An adequate number of candidates, category-wise, are called based on written test performance. The interview carries 100 marks. Qualifying marks are decided by the Bank.

Shortlisted candidates will be called for the interview round. SBI will share the interview schedule, venue and call letter through the official website. Until then, candidates should:

  • Check the Careers and Recruitment Results pages of sbi.bank.in regularly.
  • Keep their registration number and login details safe for downloading the call letter.
  • Prepare for the interview, which carries 30% weightage in the final merit.

Documents to Keep Ready for the Interview Stage

  • Recent passport-size photographs

The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) has released the RBI Assistant Mains Result 2026 for the recruitment of Assistant (Panel Year 2025) against 650 vacancies. The result is for candidates who appeared in the Mains Examination held on 7 June 2026, and it has been published on 24 September 2026 in PDF format at opportunities.rbi.org.in. Candidates whose roll numbers appear in the result PDF are shortlisted for the next and final stage of selection the Language Proficiency Test (LPT). There is no interview in this recruitment; final merit is decided purely on Mains marks, subject to qualifying the LPT.

Direct Link to Check RBI Assistant Mains Result 2026

RBI Assistant Mains Result 2026 PDF Download

RBI has published two documents alongside the Mains Result: the roll-number list of qualified candidates, and an accompanying result notice. Both are available directly from the official RBI document server.

Document Link
RBI Assistant Mains Result 2026 (Roll Numbers) Download PDF

How to Check RBI Assistant Mains Result 2026

  1. Visit the official RBI website, rbi.org.in, or the Opportunities Portal at opportunities.rbi.org.in.
  2. Go to the "Opportunities @ RBI" section and open "Current Vacancies" → "Results".
  3. Click on the link for the RBI Assistant Mains Result 2026 (Panel Year 2025).
  4. Download the result PDF to your device.
  5. Open the PDF and press Ctrl+F to search for your roll number.
  6. If your roll number appears in the list, you have qualified for the Language Proficiency Test.

What After RBI Assistant Mains Result 2026?

Candidates shortlisted in the Mains Result must now appear for the Language Proficiency Test (LPT), the final stage of the RBI Assistant selection process. The LPT tests a candidate's ability to read, write, speak, and understand the official/local language of the RBI office for which they applied. Candidates who studied the relevant local language up to the 10th or 12th standard are generally exempted; others must appear for and clear the LPT to remain in contention for final selection. The LPT is qualifying in nature no marks from it are added to the final merit list, but clearing it is mandatory. RBI is yet to announce the exact LPT schedule, venue, and reporting-time details for this cycle; candidates should watch the official portal for this notification.

RBI Assistant Selection Process 2026

  • Preliminary Examination: Qualifying stage only. Prelims marks are not counted towards the final merit list.
  • Main Examination: The Mains score is what decides a candidate's final rank and selection.
  • Language Proficiency Test (LPT): Qualifying stage. Candidates must demonstrate proficiency in the local/regional language of the RBI office applied for. There is no interview stage in this recruitment.

Documents to Keep Ready for the Language Proficiency Test

  • Category/EWS/PwBD certificate, where applicable

Forgot Registration Number or Password?

If you have misplaced your registration number or password, you can retrieve it using the steps below:

  1. Visit the official website, ibps.in.
  2. On the login page, click on the PO/MT examination admit card link.
  3. Click on the "Forgot Password?" button.
  4. Enter your registration number along with your registered mobile number or email ID.
  5. Click submit a new password will be sent to your registered email.

Important Instructions for the IBPS PO Mains Exam

Candidates must follow these exam-day guidelines carefully:

  • Carry a printed copy of the IBPS PO Mains Admit Card along with an original valid photo ID proof.
  • Reach the exam centre at least 30 to 45 minutes before the reporting time mentioned on the call letter.
  • Carry 2 to 3 passport-size photographs identical to the one uploaded on the call letter.
  • Electronic devices, smartwatches, calculators, Bluetooth devices, and study materials are not allowed inside the exam hall.
  • Biometric verification will be conducted at the exam centre to maintain the integrity of the process.
  • Ensure the photograph and signature printed on the admit card are clear and legible.
  • Scribe-related documents are required only for candidates using a registered scribe under PwBD guidelines.

Documents Required for the IBPS PO Mains Exam

  • Original photo identity proof (Aadhaar Card/e-Aadhaar, PAN Card, Voter ID, Driving Licence, or Passport), along with a photocopy

What to Do in Case of an Error on the Admit Card?

If you notice any mistake or discrepancy on your IBPS PO Mains Admit Card, follow these steps:

  1. Verify your name spelling, date of birth, registration number, and category carefully.
  2. Check whether your photograph and signature are clearly visible.
  3. Confirm the centre name, shift timing, and full address are correct.

IBPS PO Mains Exam Date and Pattern 2026

The IBPS PO Mains exam will be held on 4 October 2026. It is a Computer-Based Test that evaluates candidates on Reasoning & Computer Aptitude, General/Economy/Banking Awareness, English Language, and Data Analysis & Interpretation, along with a descriptive English Language Writing Test (Essay & Letter). Negative marking applies for wrong answers in the objective sections. RRB Station Master Recruitment 2026: The Railway Recruitment Boards (RRBs) have issued recruitment information for 1,215 Station Master vacancies under CEN 08/2026. Candidates with a Bachelor's degree from a recognized university can apply, subject to the prescribed age limit of 20 to 33 years as on 1 January 2027 and A-2 medical fitness requirements. The initial basic pay is Rs. 35,400 under Level 6 of the 7th CPC Pay Matrix. Online applications are scheduled to begin on 27 October 2026 and close on 25 November 2026 at 11:59 PM through rrbapply.gov.in.

RRB Station Master Recruitment 2026 - Overview

Organization Railway Recruitment Boards (RRBs)
Department Ministry of Railways, Government of India
Advertisement Number CEN 08/2026
Post Name Station Master
Total Vacancies 1,215 (Main Notification Summary)
Qualification Bachelor's Degree or Equivalent from a Recognized University
Age Limit 20 to 33 Years as on 01 January 2027
Initial Basic Pay Rs. 35,400 (Level 6)
Medical Standard A-2
Application Mode Online
Application Last Date 25 November 2026 (11:59 PM)
Selection Process CBT, CBAT, Document Verification and Medical Examination
Job Location Indian Railways - Various Railway Zones
Application Portal rrbapply.gov.in

Important: Candidates must meet the A-2 medical standard, including the prescribed vision requirements without glasses. The supplied CEN states that candidates who have undergone LASIK or other surgery to correct refractive error are not eligible for Station Master.

RRB Station Master Recruitment 2026 Important Dates

Event Date
Indicative Notice Date 24 October 2026
Online Application Start Date 27 October 2026
Last Date to Apply Online 25 November 2026 (11:59 PM)
Last Date for Application Fee Payment 27 November 2026
Application Correction Window 28 November to 7 December 2026
CBT Examination Date WILL ANNOUNCE
CBAT Examination Date WILL ANNOUNCE

Applicants must submit the online form by 25 November 2026. Candidates who have submitted their applications can complete the prescribed fee payment by 27 November 2026. The correction facility opens after the application window closes.

RRB Station Master Vacancy 2026

The main recruitment summary of CEN 08/2026 specifies 1,215 Station Master vacancies in Level 6 of the 7th CPC Pay Matrix. Vacancies are intended for different Railway Recruitment Boards and Zonal Railways.

S. No. Post Name No. of Posts
1 Station Master 1,215
Total 1,215

Reservation for SC, ST, OBC (Non-Creamy Layer), EWS and eligible Ex-Servicemen will apply under the prescribed rules. Candidates should check the officially confirmed RRB-wise and Railway Zone-wise vacancy distribution before choosing their RRB and preferences.

RRBs may increase or decrease the number of vacancies according to the requirements of the Railway Administration.

RRB Station Master Recruitment 2026 Notification PDF

The supplied CEN 08/2026 document provides recruitment information for Station Master posts under the Ministry of Railways. Its main vacancy summary lists 1,215 posts with initial basic pay of Rs. 35,400, an age limit of 20 to 33 years and A-2 medical requirements.

The detailed document also includes examination fees, selection conditions, CBT and CBAT patterns, application instructions and certificate formats. Candidates should obtain the authenticated notification and any corrections from the official RRB website before applying.

Official Recruitment Notices: View Station Master CEN 08/2026 Notices on RRB Website

RRB Station Master Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria

Candidates must possess a Bachelor's degree or equivalent qualification from a recognized university by 25 November 2026 and satisfy the applicable age, nationality and medical requirements.

Eligibility Criteria Requirement
Post Name Station Master
Educational Qualification Degree from a Recognized University or Equivalent
Qualification Cut-Off Date 25 November 2026
Medical Fitness A-2

Important: Candidates awaiting the final results of the prescribed educational qualification are not eligible to apply. The required degree or equivalent qualification must have been obtained by the application closing date.

Nationality Requirements

Applicants must be Indian citizens or belong to other nationality categories specifically permitted in the notification, subject to the prescribed eligibility-certificate requirements where applicable.

RRB Station Master Age Limit 2026

The prescribed age limit is 20 to 33 years as on 1 January 2027, with relaxation for eligible categories.

Age Criteria Details
Minimum Age 20 Years
Maximum Age 33 Years
Age Calculation Date 1 January 2027
UR/EWS Date of Birth Range 2 January 1994 to 1 January 2007

Category-Wise Date of Birth Criteria

Category Not Born Before Not Born After
UR/EWS 2 January 1994 1 January 2007
OBC-NCL 2 January 1991 1 January 2007
SC/ST 2 January 1989 1 January 2007

RRB Station Master Age Relaxation

Category Relaxation / Maximum Age
OBC-NCL 3 Years
SC/ST 5 Years
Eligible Ex-Servicemen Service-Based Relaxation with Applicable Category Concession
Eligible Railway Group C / Erstwhile Group D Staff with Minimum 3 Years of Service - UR/EWS 40 Years
Eligible Railway Staff - OBC-NCL 43 Years
Eligible Railway Staff - SC/ST 45 Years
Widowed / Divorced / Judicially Separated Women Not Remarried - UR/EWS 35 Years
Widowed / Divorced / Judicially Separated Women Not Remarried - OBC-NCL 38 Years
Widowed / Divorced / Judicially Separated Women Not Remarried - SC/ST 40 Years

The notification also provides relaxation for eligible personnel working in quasi-administrative Railway offices. Candidates eligible under multiple relaxation categories will receive the highest applicable relaxation, not cumulative benefits.

RRB Station Master Medical Standard 2026

Station Master candidates must satisfy the A-2 medical standard, including strict unaided vision requirements.

Medical Requirement Prescribed Standard
Medical Category A-2
Distant Vision 6/9, 6/9 without Glasses
Near Vision Sn 0.6, 0.6 without Glasses
Colour Vision Must Pass
Binocular Vision Must Pass
Night Vision Must Pass
Myopic Vision Must Pass

LASIK Surgery Restriction: According to the supplied CEN, candidates who have undergone LASIK surgery or another surgical procedure to correct refractive error are not eligible for the Station Master post.

Candidates shortlisted for CBAT must produce the prescribed original medical vision certificate as per Annexure-VI or Annexure-VIA, whichever applies. Candidates without the required certificate will not be permitted to appear in CBAT.

Failure to meet the A-2 medical requirements may result in rejection, and no alternative appointment will be offered for medical unsuitability.

RRB Station Master Salary 2026

Station Master posts carry initial basic pay of Rs. 35,400 per month under Pay Level 6 of the 7th Central Pay Commission.

Salary Particulars Details
Post Name Station Master
Pay Level Level 6
Initial Basic Pay Rs. 35,400
Pay Structure 7th CPC Pay Matrix
Allowances As Admissible under Railway Rules

The notified Rs. 35,400 amount is the initial basic pay, not the final in-hand salary. Gross and take-home salary will depend on applicable allowances and deductions.

RRB Station Master Application Fee 2026

The application fee is Rs. 500 for general fee categories and Rs. 250 for eligible concession categories. Candidates who appear in the CBT may receive the applicable refund after deduction of bank charges.

Candidate Category Application Fee Refund on Appearing in CBT
All Candidates Except Concessional Categories Rs. 500 Rs. 400, less Applicable Bank Charges
Female, Transgender, Ex-Servicemen, SC, ST, Minority Communities and Eligible EBC Candidates Rs. 250 Rs. 250, less Applicable Bank Charges

Application Fee Refund Conditions

  • Candidates must appear in the CBT to qualify for the applicable fee refund.
  • The refund will be credited to the Aadhaar-seeded bank account confirmed during the application process.
  • Applicants are responsible for ensuring that their linked bank account is valid and operational.
  • No refund is admissible for rejected or incomplete applications under the stated conditions.
  • Economically Backward Class (EBC) fee concession is different from EWS and OBC reservation.
  • Candidates claiming EBC fee concession must possess the required valid income or supporting certificate by the application closing date.

Payment Mode: Internet Banking, Debit Card, Credit Card or UPI through the prescribed online payment facility.

RRB Station Master Selection Process 2026

The selection process includes a single-stage Computer Based Test (CBT), Computer Based Aptitude Test (CBAT), Document Verification and Medical Examination.

  1. Computer Based Test: Eligible candidates appear in the objective examination, and normalized CBT scores are used for CBAT shortlisting.
  2. Computer Based Aptitude Test: Candidates shortlisted from the CBT must qualify in each prescribed CBAT test battery.
  3. Document Verification: Candidates are called according to combined CBT and CBAT merit, Railway preferences and vacancies.
  4. Medical Examination: Candidates must meet the prescribed A-2 medical fitness standard.

Selection Shortlisting and Merit Weightage

Particulars Selection Rule
CBAT Shortlisting Normally 8 Times the RRB-Wise Vacancies
Document Verification Shortlisting Normally 1:1 of RRB-Wise Vacancies
CBT Weightage 70%
CBAT Weightage 30%
Final Selection Combined Merit, CBAT Qualification, Documents and Medical Fitness

CBAT shortlisting numbers may increase or decrease according to the requirements of the Railway Administration.

RRB Station Master Exam Pattern 2026

The CBT comprises 100 multiple-choice questions for 100 marks with a duration of 120 minutes. There is a penalty of one-third of the marks assigned to a question for each incorrect answer.

Subject Questions Marks
Basic Science, Mathematical and Analytical Capability 60 60
Logical Capability 20 20
Mental Reasoning 20 20
Total 100 100
Exam Mode Computer Based Test
Duration 120 Minutes
Negative Marking One-Third of Marks per Wrong Answer
Normalization Applicable for CBT Conducted in Multiple Shifts

Minimum CBT Qualifying Marks

Category Minimum Qualifying Percentage
UR 40%
EWS 40%
OBC-NCL 30%
SC 30%
ST 25%

The minimum qualifying marks establish examination eligibility but do not guarantee shortlisting for CBAT.

RRB Station Master Syllabus 2026

The CBT syllabus includes Basic Science, Mathematics, Data Analysis and Interpretation, Logical Capability and Mental Reasoning.

Basic Science, Mathematical and Analytical Capability - 60 Marks

  • Number System, Ratio and Proportion, Averages and Percentages.
  • Profit, Loss, Discount, Time, Speed, Distance, Power and Work.
  • Algebra, Linear Equations, Arithmetic Progression, LCM and HCF.
  • Geometry, Trigonometry, Area and Volume.
  • Basic Probability and Statistics.
  • Units, Measurements, Mass, Weight, Density, Energy, Friction, Heat and Temperature.
  • Basic Electricity, Levers and Simple Machines.
  • Data Interpretation through Tables, Charts, Graphs, Pie Charts and Scatter Plots.
  • Venn Diagrams, Data Sufficiency and Data Arrangement.

Logical Capability - 20 Marks

  • Binary Logic and Syllogism.
  • Clocks and Calendars.
  • Assumptions and Blood Relations.
  • Family Trees and Logic-Based Puzzles.
  • English Reading Comprehension.

Mental Reasoning - 20 Marks

  • Analogy.
  • Series Completion.
  • Coding and Decoding.
  • Ranking and Arrangement Problems.

The topics listed in the notification are illustrative and may not represent an exhaustive question list.

RRB Station Master CBAT 2026

The Computer Based Aptitude Test (CBAT) is mandatory for candidates shortlisted through CBT. Candidates must secure a minimum T-score of 42 in each CBAT test battery, without category-wise relaxation.

CBAT Particulars Details
Shortlisting Normally 8 Times RRB-Wise Vacancies
Minimum T-Score 42 in Each Test Battery
Language English and Hindi
Negative Marking No
Vision Certificate Mandatory in Prescribed Original Format
Final Merit Weightage CBT 70% + CBAT 30%

Candidates must qualify in every test battery to be considered for the final merit list. There is no relaxation in the minimum T-score for SC, ST, OBC-NCL, EWS or Ex-Servicemen candidates.

RRB Station Master Apply Online 2026

The online application process is scheduled to begin on 27 October 2026 through the official Railway Recruitment Boards application portal.

Application Status: Scheduled to open on 27 October 2026.

Apply Online: RRB Station Master Recruitment 2026 Online Application Portal

Last Date: 25 November 2026, 11:59 PM.

Applicants must select only one Railway Recruitment Board. Submission of multiple applications to the same or different RRBs may result in rejection and disqualification.

How to Apply Online for RRB Station Master Recruitment 2026?

  1. Visit the unified Railway Recruitment Boards website at rrb.indianrailways.gov.in.
  2. Open the Station Master Recruitment 2026 notification under CEN 08/2026.
  3. Read the eligibility, age, medical fitness and vacancy conditions carefully.
  4. Open the authorized online application portal at rrbapply.gov.in when the application facility becomes active.
  5. Create an account if applying through the RRB portal for the first time, or sign in using existing RRB account credentials.
  6. Enter the required personal information and complete the prescribed account authentication.
  7. Provide the educational qualification and applicable category details.
  8. Select one RRB and indicate the Railway Zone preferences available for the selected RRB.
  9. Capture a live photograph using a webcam or mobile camera according to the portal instructions.
  10. Upload the scanned signature and applicable supporting documents.
  11. Review the application carefully, including the RRB selection and personal details.
  12. Submit the online application and complete the applicable fee payment.
  13. Save or print the application confirmation and payment details for future reference.

Important: Details entered during account creation, including registered mobile number and email address, cannot be modified afterward. The chosen RRB also cannot be changed through the subsequent correction window.

RRB Station Master Document Upload Requirements 2026

The application process requires live photograph capture rather than uploading a previously saved passport-size photograph.

Document Requirement
Live Photograph Captured Using Webcam or Mobile Camera Against a Plain White Background
Signature JPG/JPEG, 30 KB to 49 KB, Black Ink on White Paper
Signature Dimensions Minimum 140 x 60 Pixels
SC/ST Certificate for Free Railway Travel PDF, Less Than 400 KB, if Applicable

The signature must be written in running handwriting and must not be in block or capital letters. Applicants should keep original educational, date-of-birth, identity, category and other applicable certificates ready for future document verification.

RRB Station Master Application Correction 2026

The correction window is scheduled from 28 November to 7 December 2026. Applicants who have submitted the application and paid the prescribed fee can modify permitted details by paying a non-refundable modification fee of Rs. 250 per occasion.

Particulars Details
Correction Start Date 28 November 2026
Correction Last Date 7 December 2026
Modification Fee Rs. 250 per Occasion
Restricted Details Create an Account Details and Chosen RRB

Candidates cannot modify the email ID, mobile number or other details entered during account creation. No application correction requests will be entertained after the correction window closes.

RRB Station Master Recruitment 2026 Important Instructions

  • Only one application to one selected RRB is permitted.
  • Candidates must possess the required educational qualification by 25 November 2026.
  • The A-2 medical standard is mandatory for Station Master.
  • Candidates who have undergone LASIK or other refractive-error correction surgery are ineligible under the supplied medical conditions.
  • CBAT requires a minimum T-score of 42 in each test battery.
  • The original prescribed vision certificate must be produced at the CBAT stage.
  • Final merit gives 70% weightage to CBT and 30% to CBAT.
  • Applicants should use their own active mobile number and email address.
  • Wrong or false application details may lead to rejection or cancellation of candidature.
  • Examination dates, city details and admit cards will be announced through the official RRB websites.
  • The number of notified vacancies is provisional and may change according to Railway requirements.

  • A candidate must be a citizen of India, a subject of Nepal or Bhutan, a Tibetan refugee who came to India before 1 January 1962 with the intention of settling permanently, or a person of Indian origin who has migrated from Pakistan, Burma, Sri Lanka, East African countries of Kenya, Uganda, the United Republic of Tanzania, Zambia, Malawi, Zaire, Ethiopia or Vietnam with the intention of settling permanently in India. Candidates in the last four groups must hold a certificate of eligibility issued by the Government of India.
  • The minimum age to apply for all the posts is 18 years.
  • All qualifications must be from a University/Institution/Board recognized by the Government of India or approved by Government regulatory bodies. Candidates appearing in the final year or final semester are not eligible.
  • Where SGPA/CGPA/OGPA is awarded, it should be converted into equivalent percentage in the online application.
  • No change of category is permitted after registration.

CWC Recruitment 2026 Qualification

The post-wise CWC qualification and experience are given below.

Post Name (Post Code) Educational Qualification Experience
Assistant Manager (General) (01) Two years Post Graduation Degree/Post Graduation Diploma in any discipline Nil
Assistant Manager (Technical) (02) Bachelor of Technology or Bachelor of Engineering in Agriculture/Food Technology/Food Science/Food Science and Technology/Food Technology Management/Biotechnology Nil
Assistant Manager (Finance) (03) Graduate in Commerce with three years' post qualification experience in Finance & Accounting, OR Graduate in any discipline with CA Intermediate/CMA Intermediate 3 years (for the Commerce graduate route)
Assistant Manager (Engineering)-Civil (04) Bachelor of Engineering or Bachelor of Technology in Civil Engineering Nil
Assistant Manager (Engineering)-Electrical (05) Bachelor of Engineering or Bachelor of Technology in Electrical Engineering, or in Electrical and Electronics Engineering Nil
Assistant Manager (Engineering)-Mechanical (06) Bachelor of Engineering or Bachelor of Technology in Mechanical Engineering Nil
Junior Executive (General) (07) Graduate in any discipline with working knowledge in computer applications, MS Office etc. Nil
Junior Executive (Technical) (08) B.Sc. (Agriculture)/B.Sc. (Botany)/B.Sc. (Zoology)/B.Sc. (Biotechnology)/B.Sc. (Microbiology)/B.Sc. (Biochemistry)/B.Sc. (Food Science)/B.Sc. (Chemistry), with working knowledge in computer applications, MS Office etc. Nil

For the post of Assistant Manager (Finance), the period of articleship is not counted in the required experience. Only regular employment experience is counted.

CWC Recruitment 2026 Age Limit

The CWC age limit is a maximum of 28 years as on 15.11.2026 for all the posts. Candidates should not have been born earlier than 16.11.1998 and later than 15.11.2008, both days inclusive. The maximum age in Table-A is applicable to UR candidates, and the following relaxation is given on top of it.

Category Age Relaxation
Scheduled Caste/Scheduled Tribe 5 years
Other Backward Class (Non-Creamy Layer) 3 years
Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBD) 10 years
Ex-Servicemen, Commissioned Officers including ECOs/SSCOs who have rendered at least 5 years of military service and been released on completion of assignment (including those whose assignment is due to complete within one year of the last date), otherwise than by dismissal or discharge on account of misconduct, inefficiency or physical disability attributable to military service or invalidment 5 years, subject to the ceiling as per Government guidelines
Ex-Servicemen for the post codes 07 and 08 3 years after deducting the number of years of military service
Persons affected by 1984 riots 5 years
  • With cumulative age relaxation, the maximum age limit cannot exceed 55 years as on 15.11.2026.
  • For Ex-Servicemen (post codes 07 and 08), the period of actual military service is deducted from the actual age, and the resultant age should not exceed the maximum age limit by more than 3 years (8 years for SC/ST and 6 years for OBC candidates).
  • The relaxation for SC/ST/OBC (Non-Creamy Layer) candidates is allowed on a cumulative basis with any one of the other categories listed above, except SC/ST/OBC themselves.
  • Departmental candidates (regular CWC employees) get age relaxation only if they have at least 5 years of service left on the last date of receipt of applications.
  • Age concession is not admissible to sons, daughters and dependents of Ex-Servicemen. SC/ST/OBC/EWS candidates applying against unreserved posts get no age or qualifying-marks relaxation.

CWC Recruitment 2026 Salary

The CWC salary for the Assistant Manager posts is Rs. 40000-140000 in the E-1 scale, and for the Junior Executive posts it is Rs. 29000-93000 in the S-V scale (IDA pattern). Besides basic pay and IDA, candidates are entitled to other allowances, perks and benefits as per the policies of the Corporation. The notification also lists CPF, contributory pension, gratuity, LTC, performance related pay or variable pay, and medical reimbursement as admissible for regular employees.

Post Name Scale of Pay (IDA)
Assistant Manager (all six posts, codes 01 to 06) Rs. 40000-140000 (E-1)
Junior Executive (General and Technical, codes 07 and 08) Rs. 29000-93000 (S-V)

Selected candidates are appointed on probation. Assistant Manager candidates have to furnish a bond of Rs. 1,00,000 and Junior Executive candidates a bond of Rs. 50,000, to serve the Corporation for a minimum of two years, at the time of joining.

CWC Recruitment 2026 Application Fee

The CWC application fee is Rs. 850 plus intimation charges of Rs. 500 (Rs. 1,350 in total) for UR, EWS and OBC candidates. SC, ST, PwBD, Ex-Servicemen and women candidates are exempt from the application fee but must pay intimation charges of Rs. 500. The amount is inclusive of GST, and the payment gateway charges are borne by the candidate.

Category Application Fee Intimation Charges Total
SC, ST, PwBD, Ex-Serviceman and women candidates Nil Rs. 500 Rs. 500/-
Other candidates (UR/EWS/OBC) Rs. 850 Rs. 500 Rs. 1,350/-
  • The fee is non-refundable and is paid through the online payment gateway only. Payment by DD, cheque or postal order is not accepted.
  • Payment can be made by debit card (RuPay/Visa/MasterCard/Maestro), credit card, internet banking, UPI, IMPS, cash cards or mobile wallets.
  • A candidate applying for more than one post must apply and pay the fee separately for each post.
  • On successful payment, an e-receipt is generated. If no e-receipt is generated, the payment has failed, and the candidate should log in again with the Provisional Registration Number and Password and repeat the payment.

CWC Recruitment 2026 Selection Process

The CWC selection process depends on the post. Candidates must first register for the online recruitment process for each post.

Post Code Selection Process
01, 02, 03, 04, 05 and 06 (Assistant Manager posts) Online Test + Document Verification followed by Interview
07 and 08 (Junior Executive posts) Online Test + Document Verification
  • Candidates are shortlisted from the online test in the ratio of 1:5 for the Assistant Manager posts (Interview) and 1:3 for the Junior Executive posts (Document Verification). The Interview and Document Verification are conducted at Delhi.
  • For the Assistant Manager posts, the Interview carries 30 marks. The minimum qualifying marks in the Interview are 50% for Unreserved and EWS candidates, 45% for OBC and 40% for SC/ST/PwBD/Ex-Servicemen candidates. The weightage of the online exam and the Interview is 85:15.
  • For the Junior Executive posts, appointment is based on the marks obtained in the online test, after successful Document Verification.
  • Each candidate must obtain a minimum score in each section and a minimum total score. The minimum qualifying marks for the Professional/Subject Knowledge test (posts 02 to 06 and 08) and for the Language & Comprehension Abilities Descriptive Test (all posts) are 40% for Unreserved and 35% for OBC/EWS/SC/ST/PwBD/Ex-Servicemen candidates.
  • If two or more candidates get the same score, the senior candidate by date of birth is placed higher. A wait list up to 100% of the vacancies in each category may be kept.
  • Cut-offs are applied in two stages, on the scores in individual tests and on the total score. If the exam is held in more than one session, the scores are equated and normalized.

CWC Recruitment 2026 Exam Pattern

The online examination is of 3 hours in total, with each test separately timed. There is a penalty of one-fourth of the marks of the question for each wrong answer, and there is no penalty for an unanswered question. Each post has 202 questions and 230 maximum marks.

Assistant Manager (Technical), (Finance), (Engineering)-Civil, (Engineering)-Electrical and (Engineering)-Mechanical

CWC reserves the right to modify the structure of the examination. Other details will be given in an Information Handout, available with the call letters on www.cewacor.nic.in. The tentative list of exam centres across states and union territories is given in Annexure I of the notification, and the choice of centre once made is final.

CWC Recruitment 2026 Syllabus

The notification says the syllabus is broad and indicative and may change slightly in the examination. The professional/subject knowledge topics are as follows.

  • Assistant Manager (Technical) (02): Agricultural Process Engineering and Storage Systems; Food Engineering and Preservation; Food Chemistry and Nutrition; Food Microbiology and Pest Control; General Biology and Biotechnology; Grain Storage, Quality Control and Chemical Preservation.
  • Assistant Manager (Finance) (03): Financial Accounting (Ind AS, GAAP, bank reconciliation, cash flow statement, final accounts, payroll accounting, cost accounting); Taxation (Income Tax Act, 2025 and Goods and Services Tax Act, 2017); Auditing (company audit, audit reports and certificates, ledger scrutiny, internal control).
  • Assistant Manager (Engineering)-Civil (04): Structural Engineering; Geotechnical Engineering and Geomatics Engineering; Water Resources Engineering; Environmental Engineering; Transportation Engineering; Surveying; Project Management and Planning; Concrete Technology and Prestressed Concrete.
  • Assistant Manager (Engineering)-Electrical (05): Electric Circuits; Electromagnetic Fields; Signals and Systems; Electrical Machines; Power Systems; Control Systems; Electrical and Electronic Measurements; Analog and Digital Electronics; Power Electronics.
  • Assistant Manager (Engineering)-Mechanical (06): Applied Mechanics and Machine Design; Thermal Engineering and Fluid Mechanics; Manufacturing Technology and Engineering Materials; Production Engineering; Industrial Engineering.
  • Junior Executive (Technical) (08): Basic Agriculture; Botany; Zoology; Chemistry; Physics.

The detailed sub-topics for each of these are given in the notification PDF.

Documents Required for CWC Recruitment 2026

The following documents, in original along with a self-attested photocopy, are required at the time of Interview/Document Verification, as applicable.

  • Valid Interview/Document Verification call letter with a 4.5 cm x 3.5 cm photograph pasted
  • System generated printout of the online application form
  • Proof of date of birth (Birth Certificate or SSLC/Std. X certificate with date of birth)
  • Photo identity proof (see the identity verification section of the notification)
  • Mark sheets and certificates for educational qualifications from Std. X onwards
  • Caste certificate in the prescribed format for SC/ST/OBC candidates. OBC (Non-Creamy Layer) certificate based on the income for FY 2025-26, 2024-25 and 2023-24, issued on or after 01.04.2026 and not later than 15.11.2026.
  • EWS candidates: Income and Asset Certificate in the prescribed format for FY 2025-26, valid for 2026-27 and in possession on or before 15.11.2026
  • PwBD candidates: Disability certificate in the prescribed format issued by the District Medical Board, and the scribe details if a scribe was used
  • Ex-Servicemen: Copy of the discharge certificate/pension payment order and documentary proof of rank. Those still in defence service must submit a certificate that they will be relieved on or before 15.11.2027.
  • Candidates serving in Government/Quasi-Government offices/PSUs: No Objection Certificate from the employer
  • 1984 riot affected persons: Certificate from the District Magistrate. Candidates in the non-Indian-citizen categories: certificate of eligibility issued by the Government of India.

Candidates should not send documents directly to CWC before or after Document Verification. Outstation candidates called for Document Verification/Interview are reimbursed A.C. III tier rail fare/bus fare or actual expenses, whichever is less, on production of proof of travel.

How to Apply for CWC Recruitment 2026

Candidates can apply online only from 17.10.2026 to 15.11.2026. No other mode of application is accepted. A candidate can apply for one or more posts according to the qualification and eligibility, but must apply and pay the fee separately for each post. Not more than one application should be submitted for a particular post.

CWC Recruitment 2026 Apply Online

  1. Keep ready a scanned photograph, signature, left thumb impression and a hand-written declaration, a valid personal e-mail ID and mobile number, and the details for online payment.
  2. Go to www.cewacor.nic.in, click the link "Career @CWC (Direct Recruitment)-2026" and then "Click here to apply online for Advertisement No. 2026/01".
  3. Choose "Click here for New Registration" and enter the name, contact details and e-mail ID. A Provisional Registration Number and Password are generated and also sent by e-mail and SMS.
  4. Fill in the application form. The "Save and Next" option can be used to save the data and verify it. The name of the candidate and the father/husband must be spelt as in the Class 10 certificate/mark sheet.
  5. Upload the photograph, signature, left thumb impression and hand-written declaration, and capture the live photograph by webcam or mobile phone.
  6. Preview the form, click "Complete Registration" after verifying, then use the "Payment" tab to pay the fee and click "Submit".
  7. Take a printout of the application form and the e-receipt. Do not send them to CWC.

Documents to Upload

Document Specification
Photograph Recent passport style colour photograph, 4.5 cm x 3.5 cm, file size 20 KB to 50 KB (200 x 230 pixels preferred)
Signature On white paper with black ink (not in capital letters), file size 10 KB to 20 KB (140 x 60 pixels preferred)
Left Thumb Impression On white paper with black or blue ink, JPG/JPEG, 3 cm x 3 cm (240 x 240 pixels at 200 DPI), file size 20 KB to 50 KB
Hand-written Declaration In English, in the candidate's own handwriting (not in capital letters), JPG/JPEG, 10 cm x 5 cm (800 x 400 pixels at 200 DPI), file size 50 KB to 100 KB

The text of the declaration is: "I, (Name of the candidate), hereby declare that all the information submitted by me in the application form is correct, true and valid. I will present the supporting documents as and when required." Visually impaired candidates or others who cannot write may get the text typed and put their left thumb impression below it. The online application is not registered unless the photograph, signature, left thumb impression and hand-written declaration are uploaded as specified.

CWC Recruitment 2026 Important Instructions

  • All details in the online application, including name, category, date of birth, post, address, mobile number, e-mail ID and exam centre, are final, and no change is allowed after submission.
  • Online applications cannot be withdrawn, and the fee is neither refunded nor held in reserve for any other examination. For multiple applications for the same post, only the latest valid application is retained and the fee for the others is forfeited.
  • Candidature at every stage is provisional. CWC can cancel the candidature at any stage if the candidate does not meet the eligibility norms or has given false information.
  • Candidates must carry the call letter, the original photo identity proof and its photocopy to the exam. The name on the call letter must match the photo identity proof. Ration cards and learner's driving licences are not accepted as ID proof.
  • Biometric data (left thumb impression) and a photograph are captured on the day of the exam and verified at Document Verification/Interview.
  • Candidates reporting late are not permitted to take the exam. Candidates may need to be at the venue for up to 4 hours or more.
  • Items not allowed in the exam centre include mobile phones, Bluetooth devices, calculators, watches, handbags, belts, caps, metallic items and eatables. Only half-sleeved clothing and open-toe footwear are allowed.
  • Use of unfair means can lead to disqualification, debarment and an FIR. CWC analyses the answers of candidates to detect similarity patterns.
  • Candidates with disabilities using a scribe get compensatory time of 20 minutes per hour or as advised. The scribe must be one step lower in qualification and must not be a candidate for any post in this advertisement.
  • Intimations are sent by e-mail and SMS only. All announcements and any corrigendum are published only on www.cewacor.nic.in. In case of a dispute over interpretation, the English version prevails.
  • Appointment is subject to medical fitness. No person dismissed or compulsorily retired from CWC, a State or Central Government department or a PSU, or convicted for an offence involving moral turpitude, is eligible.

BHEL Artisan Recruitment 2027: Bharat Heavy Electricals Limited (BHEL) has announced 660 Artisan Grade-IV vacancies under Advertisement No. 01/2026. Recruitment is being conducted for Fitter, Welder, Turner, Machinist, Electrician, Electronics Mechanic and Foundryman trades across nine manufacturing units. Candidates with Class 10, a National Trade Certificate (NTC/ITI) and a National Apprenticeship Certificate (NAC) in the respective trade can apply online from 21 October to 18 November 2026. Selected candidates will initially receive Rs. 24,000 per month during the one-year temporary period.

BHEL Artisan Eligibility Criteria 2027

Educational Qualification

Candidates must possess all three of the following qualifications in the relevant trade:

  1. Class 10 or Matriculation.
  2. National Trade Certificate (NTC/ITI).
  3. National Apprenticeship Certificate (NAC).

The qualification cut-off date is 1 October 2026. Candidates must have obtained the required ITI/NTC and NAC certificates or marksheets by this date.

Minimum Marks Requirement

Category Minimum Marks
General and OBC 60% in both NTC/ITI and NAC
SC and ST 55% in both NTC/ITI and NAC, subject to the applicable reservation conditions

Only full-time regular courses will be considered. The National Apprenticeship Certificate must be issued by the competent authority.

Special Condition: SC/ST/PwBD candidates applying against vacancies not reserved for their respective categories will be considered under general merit standards, without relaxation in the minimum educational percentage. Eligible Ex-servicemen claiming prescribed trade equivalency may receive the notified exemption from minimum marks requirements.

Desirable Language Knowledge

Knowledge of the regional language is desirable for manufacturing units in Tamil Nadu, Telangana, Andhra Pradesh and Karnataka. Hindi knowledge is desirable for the other manufacturing units.

The upper age limit for General and EWS candidates is 27 years as of 1 October 2026.

Maximum Age Ceiling: The age of a candidate, including all permissible relaxations, must not exceed 56 years as of 1 October 2026.

BHEL Artisan Salary 2027

Selected candidates will initially work as Temporary Artisans for one year with consolidated monthly wages of Rs. 24,000.

Artisan Grade-IV After Regularization Rs. 29,500 - 65,000

Upon successful completion of the temporary period, candidates will be regularized in the Artisan Grade-IV establishment according to the prevailing company rules. Applicable allowances will be provided as per the rules in force at regularization.

BHEL Artisan Selection Process 2027

Selection is conducted through a two-stage process consisting of a Computer Based Examination followed by Document Verification and a qualifying Skill Test.

  1. Stage I: Computer Based Examination (CBE).
  2. Stage II: Document Verification and Skill Test.
  3. Final Merit: Based on CBE marks among candidates found eligible in document verification and qualified in the Skill Test.

Candidates are generally shortlisted for the Skill Test in the ratio of 1:3 against the available category-wise vacancies for the relevant unit and trade. For a single vacancy in a trade/category, up to five candidates may be shortlisted.

Computer Based Examination Minimum Qualifying Marks

Category Minimum Qualifying Marks
UR/EWS 40%
OBC (NCL), SC and ST 30%

For eligible PwBD and Ex-servicemen candidates, the notification permits further qualifying-mark relaxation under specified conditions, subject to minimum standards of 30% for UR/EWS and 22.5% for OBC/SC/ST.

The Skill Test is qualifying in nature. Final merit is determined by CBE marks after successful completion of document verification and the Skill Test.

BHEL Artisan Exam Pattern 2027

The BHEL Artisan Computer Based Examination will contain 120 multiple-choice questions carrying 120 marks, with a duration of 90 minutes.

Reasoning 20 20
Total 120 120
  • Examination Mode: Computer Based Examination
  • Question Type: Objective Multiple Choice
  • Total Questions: 120
  • Total Marks: 120
  • Examination Duration: 90 Minutes
  • Correct Answer: 1 Mark
  • Incorrect Answer: Deduction of 0.25 Mark
  • Languages: Hindi, English and one selected regional language option

The examination will be trilingual. Candidates may choose Hindi, English or a notified regional language such as Kannada, Telugu or Tamil. Where the English and Hindi versions differ, the English version will be treated as authentic.

BHEL Artisan Syllabus 2027

According to the official examination pattern, candidates will be tested in three areas:

Section Coverage

Engineering / Calculations Engineering-related calculations and knowledge assessed in the examination
Reasoning Reasoning ability

The supplied examination pattern document specifies the number of questions for each section but does not provide a detailed chapter-wise syllabus. Candidates should follow any subsequent trade-specific syllabus or examination instructions published by BHEL.

BHEL Artisan Posting and Transfer Conditions

Selected candidates must serve at their allocated manufacturing unit for at least 20 years from the date of joining. Requests for transfer or change in place of posting will not be entertained during the first 20 years.

The notification also specifies that any transfer considered in exceptional personal circumstances would be subject to availability of a suitable position and other company conditions.

Applicants should therefore choose the manufacturing unit carefully, considering long-term employment and location preferences.

How to Apply for BHEL Artisan Recruitment 2027

  1. Visit the official BHEL Careers website at careers.bhel.in.
  2. Find Artisan Recruitment 2027 - Advertisement No. 01/2026.
  3. Read the detailed recruitment advertisement and examination instructions.

For RRB NTPC Graduate CEN 06/2026, candidates are not required to upload a pre-existing passport photograph. The application portal will capture a live photograph during the online application process.

RRB NTPC Live Photo Requirements

  • The photograph must be captured live using a computer/laptop webcam or mobile phone front camera.
  • Use a pure plain white background.
  • Wear non-white clothing, preferably a plain dark colour, to maintain contrast.
  • Look directly at the camera with a neutral expression.
  • The entire face must be clearly visible and centered.
  • The head should occupy at least 50% of the photograph area.
  • Do not wear a cap, mask or spectacles while capturing the photograph.
  • Do not photograph a printed or existing digital photograph.

Important: Since the photograph is captured live, there is no separate RRB NTPC photo upload size or KB requirement for a pre-existing photograph under CEN 06/2026.

Minimum Dimensions 140 × 60 pixels

The signature must be written by the candidate in normal running handwriting. Signatures written in BLOCK LETTERS, CAPITAL LETTERS or disjointed letters are not accepted.

If the scanned signature does not meet the RRB NTPC upload requirements, candidates can use the OnlyJobs Image Resizer to resize and compress it before uploading.

For RRB NTPC Graduate CEN 06/2026, keep the signature in JPG/JPEG format, between 30 KB and 49 KB, with minimum dimensions of 140 × 60 pixels.

How to Resize RRB NTPC Signature

  1. Sign on white paper using a black ink pen.
  2. Scan the signature clearly.
  3. Open the OnlyJobs Image Resizer.
  4. Keep the image dimensions at least 140 × 60 pixels.
  5. Compress the file to between 30 KB and 49 KB.
  6. Save the final image in JPG or JPEG format.
  7. Check that the signature is complete, clear and clearly visible before uploading.

  • Candidates possessing qualifications higher than Class 12.

Can Graduates Apply for RRB NTPC Undergraduate Recruitment 2026?

Yes. Candidates with qualifications higher than Class 12 can apply for the undergraduate posts if they satisfy the prescribed age, medical and other eligibility conditions. The 50% Class 12 minimum marks condition is not insisted upon for such candidates.

RRB NTPC Undergraduate Age Limit 2026

The age limit for all four RRB NTPC Undergraduate posts is 18 to 30 years as on 1 January 2027. Age relaxation is available to eligible reserved and other notified categories.

Particulars Age Limit
Minimum Age 18 Years
Maximum Age (UR/EWS) 30 Years
Age Calculation Date 01 January 2027

Category Earliest Eligible Date of Birth Latest Eligible Date of Birth
UR / EWS 02 January 1997 01 January 2009
OBC-NCL 02 January 1994 01 January 2009

Both dates are inclusive. The date of birth entered in the application must match the Class 10 or equivalent certificate.

Category Relaxation

Age relaxation is subject to the conditions and documentary requirements provided in the notification.

RRB NTPC Undergraduate Salary 2026

RRB NTPC Undergraduate posts are placed under Pay Levels 2 and 3 of the 7th Central Pay Commission. The Commercial cum Ticket Clerk post carries initial basic pay of Rs. 21,700, while the remaining three posts carry Rs. 19,900.

Post Name Pay Level Initial Basic Pay
Commercial cum Ticket Clerk Level 3 Rs. 21,700
Accounts Clerk cum Typist Level 2 Rs. 19,900
Junior Clerk cum Typist Level 2 Rs. 19,900
Trains Clerk Level 2 Rs. 19,900

These are initial basic pay figures, not the total monthly take-home salary.

RRB NTPC Undergraduate Application Fee 2026

The RRB NTPC Undergraduate application fee is Rs. 500 for general applicants and Rs. 250 for the eligible concessional categories listed in the notification. Part or all of the examination fee is refundable, after deduction of applicable bank charges, only to candidates who appear in the first-stage CBT.

Category Application Fee Refund After CBT-1
General / Other Non-exempt Candidates Rs. 500 Rs. 400, less bank charges
SC / ST Rs. 250 Rs. 250, less bank charges
Ex-Servicemen Rs. 250 Rs. 250, less bank charges
PwBD Rs. 250 Rs. 250, less bank charges
Female Candidates Rs. 250 Rs. 250, less bank charges
Transgender Candidates Rs. 250 Rs. 250, less bank charges
Minority Communities Rs. 250 Rs. 250, less bank charges
Economically Backward Class (EBC) Rs. 250 Rs. 250, less bank charges

Payment Methods: Internet Banking, Debit Card, Credit Card and UPI.

RRB NTPC Examination Fee Refund Rules 2026

  • Only candidates appearing in CBT-1 are eligible for the prescribed refund.
  • The refund is subject to deduction of applicable bank charges.
  • Refunds are processed to an Aadhaar-seeded bank account as provided in the notification.
  • Candidates must ensure their bank account is correctly linked with Aadhaar.
  • Rejected or incomplete applications do not qualify for a fee refund.

Important: Economically Backward Class (EBC), Economically Weaker Section (EWS) and Other Backward Class (OBC) are different categories. EBC concession is based on the conditions specified in the notification and does not itself provide job reservation.

RRB NTPC Undergraduate Selection Process 2026

The recruitment process consists of two Computer Based Tests, followed by document verification and medical examination. Unlike several previous NTPC recruitment cycles, CEN 07/2026 does not require a separate Computer Based Typing Skill Test for Junior Clerk cum Typist or Accounts Clerk cum Typist.

  1. CBT-1: First-stage Computer Based Test for all four posts.
  2. CBT-2: Second-stage Computer Based Test for shortlisted candidates.
  3. Document Verification: Verification of original educational, identity, category and other required documents.
  4. Medical Examination: Candidates must pass the prescribed medical fitness standard for their allotted post.

Is There a Typing Test in RRB NTPC Undergraduate Recruitment 2026?

No. The Computer Based Typing Skill Test for Junior Clerk cum Typist and Accounts Clerk cum Typist has been dispensed with under CEN 07/2026. Candidates are still expected to possess basic computer and adequate typing proficiency, which may be assessed after joining.

RRB NTPC Undergraduate CBT-1 Exam Pattern 2026

The RRB NTPC Undergraduate first-stage CBT contains 100 objective-type questions for 100 marks. The examination duration is 90 minutes, and one-third of a mark is deducted for every incorrect answer.

Subject Questions Marks
General Awareness 40 40
Mathematics 30 30
General Intelligence and Reasoning 30 30
Total 100 100

Duration: 90 Minutes.

Negative Marking: 1/3 mark per incorrect answer.

Scribe-eligible Candidates: 120 Minutes.

RRB NTPC Undergraduate CBT-2 Exam Pattern 2026

Candidates shortlisted through CBT-1 will appear for CBT-2. The second-stage CBT contains 120 questions carrying 120 marks, with a duration of 90 minutes.

Subject Questions Marks
General Awareness 50 50
Mathematics 35 35
General Intelligence and Reasoning 35 35
Total 120 120

Duration: 90 Minutes.

Negative Marking: 1/3 mark per incorrect answer.

Scribe-eligible Candidates: 120 Minutes.

Category Minimum Qualifying Percentage

EWS 40%
OBC-NCL 30%
SC 30%
ST 25%

These minimum qualifying percentages apply to the CBTs. PwBD candidates may receive the specified relaxation when the notification's conditions are met. Qualifying marks alone do not guarantee shortlisting.

RRB NTPC Undergraduate Syllabus 2026

The RRB NTPC Undergraduate syllabus for CBT-1 and CBT-2 covers Mathematics, General Intelligence and Reasoning, and General Awareness. Both stages have the same broad subjects but different question distributions.

Mathematics Syllabus

  • Number System, Decimals and Fractions
  • LCM and HCF
  • Ratio and Proportion
  • Percentages
  • Mensuration
  • Time and Work
  • Time and Distance
  • Simple and Compound Interest
  • Profit and Loss
  • Elementary Algebra
  • Geometry and Trigonometry
  • Elementary Statistics

General Intelligence and Reasoning Syllabus

  • Analogies
  • Number and Alphabetical Series
  • Coding and Decoding
  • Mathematical Operations
  • Similarities and Differences
  • Relationships and Analytical Reasoning
  • Syllogism
  • Venn Diagrams
  • Puzzles and Data Sufficiency
  • Statement and Conclusion
  • Decision Making
  • Maps and Graph Interpretation

General Awareness Syllabus

  • Current Affairs - National and International
  • Indian History and Freedom Struggle
  • Indian and World Geography
  • Indian Polity and Constitution
  • Indian Economy
  • General Science up to Class 10 Level
  • Sports, Art, Culture and Literature
  • Computer Basics and Applications
  • Science and Technology Developments
  • Government Schemes and Programmes
  • Environmental Issues
  • Indian Transport Systems
  • Important National and International Organizations

RRB NTPC Undergraduate Medical Standards 2026

Each undergraduate post has a prescribed railway medical standard. Candidates must satisfy the required fitness and vision conditions for the post they select.

Post Name Medical Standard
Commercial cum Ticket Clerk B-2
Accounts Clerk cum Typist C-2
Junior Clerk cum Typist C-2
Trains Clerk A-3

Can Candidates with LASIK Surgery Apply for RRB NTPC Undergraduate 2026?

Candidates who have undergone LASIK or another procedure to correct refractive error are not eligible for posts requiring A-3 medical standards under this notification. For B-2 and C-2 posts, eligibility is subject to the medical conditions specified in the official notification.

How to Apply Online for RRB NTPC Undergraduate Recruitment 2026

Eligible candidates must submit only one online application through the unified official RRB website from 15 October to 13 November 2026. Candidates must carefully choose the RRB and their post preferences because important details cannot be changed later.

  1. Visit https://rrb.indianrailways.gov.in/.
  2. Open the recruitment link for CEN No. 07/2026 - NTPC Undergraduate.
  3. Read the detailed notification, Annexure A and RRB-wise vacancy tables in Annexure B.
  4. Click Create an Account if you are a new applicant. Candidates who already created an RRB account for earlier CENs should use their existing login credentials.
  5. Register using the required personal details, active mobile number and email address.
  6. Complete Aadhaar or other permitted identity verification as directed by the application portal.
  7. Choose one Railway Recruitment Board.
  8. Enter the required personal, educational and reservation details.
  9. Select eligible posts, Railway Zones and Production Unit preferences carefully.
  10. Complete the live photograph capture as instructed by the portal.
  11. Upload the scanned signature and applicable supporting documents.
  12. Review the information and declaration carefully.
  13. Pay the prescribed examination fee using the available online payment method.
  14. Submit the application and retain the confirmation details.

Important: The selected RRB and details entered during Create an Account cannot be modified later. Candidates must not submit multiple applications.

RRB NTPC Undergraduate Photo and Signature Requirements 2026

The RRB application process includes live photograph capture and upload of the candidate's signature. Candidates should follow the exact instructions to avoid application rejection.

Live Photograph Requirements

  • The candidate's photograph must be captured live through the application system.
  • Do not upload or photograph an existing printed photograph.
  • Follow the portal's instructions for face positioning, lighting and identity matching.

RRB NTPC Signature Size and Format

Requirement Specification

Signature Style Running Handwriting, Not Block or Capital Letters

The notification also requires eligible SC/ST candidates seeking a free train travel pass to upload the prescribed community certificate in PDF format.

RRB NTPC Undergraduate Application Correction 2026

The RRB NTPC Undergraduate application modification window will remain open from 16 November to 25 November 2026. Candidates can change permitted application details by paying a non-refundable modification fee of Rs. 250 for each modification.

Particulars Details

Account Registration Details Cannot be modified
Chosen RRB Cannot be modified

UCO Bank Apprentice Recruitment 2026 Overview

UCO Bank invites online applications from candidates for engagement as apprentices under the Apprentices Act, 1961 (as amended). Candidates can apply for only one State/UT. Selection is through an online objective test conducted by the BFSI Sector Skill Council of India (BFSI SSC), followed by a local language test during document verification and a medical fitness check. Apprentices are trainees, not employees of the Bank, and have no right to employment after training.
