A total of 530 apprentice seats are available across 31 States/UTs. The numbers are provisional and may vary with the Bank's actual requirement, and the Bank may allot a training location in any district of the selected State/UT. There is no reservation for Ex-servicemen/Disabled Ex-servicemen, and they are not engaged as apprentices.

UCO Bank Apprentice Eligibility Criteria

UCO Bank Apprentice Qualification

Candidates must hold a graduate degree from a recognised University/Institute approved by the Government of India or its regulatory bodies. The graduation mark sheets and provisional/final degree certificate must have been issued on or after 1 April 2022.

UCO Bank Apprentice Other Eligibility Conditions

  • Nationality: A citizen of India, or a subject of Nepal or Bhutan, or a Tibetan refugee who came to India before January 1962 to settle permanently, or a person of Indian origin who migrated from Pakistan, Burma, Sri Lanka, or specified East African countries and Vietnam with the intention of settling in India (the last three categories need an eligibility certificate from the Government of India).
  • Candidates must not have undergone, or be currently undergoing, apprenticeship with UCO Bank or any other organisation, and apprentices terminated by their organisation are not eligible.
  • Candidates with training or job experience of one year or more after completing their educational qualification are not eligible.
  • Candidates applying for a particular State/UT must be proficient in reading, writing, speaking and understanding at least one local language of that State/UT. A language test is conducted during document verification; candidates who produce a 10th or 12th mark sheet showing they studied the local language are exempt.
  • Candidates may apply for only one State/UT; multiple applications will be rejected (only the last valid application is considered).

UCO Bank Apprentice Age Limit

The age limit is a minimum of 20 years and a maximum of 28 years as on 1 October 2026 (the maximum applies to Unreserved and EWS candidates).

The fee is paid online to BFSI SSC through the secure payment link in the application form, between 14 October and 29 October 2026. It is non-refundable under any circumstances, whether or not the candidate attends the test or is shortlisted, and cannot be adjusted against any other selection process.

UCO Bank Apprentice Selection Process

Online Objective Test

Name of Test No. of Questions Maximum Marks Medium

The total duration is 60 minutes. The advertisement does not mention negative marking. The minimum qualifying marks out of 100 are 40 for General/EWS and 35 for SC/ST/OBC/PwBD. The merit list is prepared State-wise and category-wise in descending order of marks; ties are broken in favour of the older candidate.

How the Online Test Is Taken

  • Eligible applicants who have paid the fee receive an exam link and login credentials from BFSI SSC on the day before the exam.
  • The test is taken from the candidate's own residence, using their own camera-enabled desktop, laptop, tablet or smartphone, in isolation from other people (except PwBD candidates).
  • Candidates must display the Aadhaar card they uploaded on the NATS portal as ID proof for image capture.
  • Failure to register for the written test results in disqualification. Responses may be analysed for similarity patterns, and results of candidates whose scores are found not genuine can be withheld.

Local Language Test, Medical Fitness and Wait List

The local language test is held during document verification. Engagement is subject to the candidate being declared medically fit as per the Bank's requirement. The Bank may declare a wait list at its discretion to cover non-acceptance or non-reporting by selected candidates.

UCO Bank Apprentice Syllabus 2026

How to Apply for UCO Bank Apprentice Recruitment 2026

UCO Bank Apprentice Apply Online

Applications are accepted online only; no hard copy of the application or documents is to be sent to the Bank. The process is:

  1. Register on NATS: Register on the National Apprenticeship Training Scheme portal (nats.education.gov.in, "Student Register/Login") and note your Enrolment ID.
  2. Apply for UCO Bank's apprenticeship: After logging in, view the "UCO Bank" apprenticeship advertisement and apply for it on the portal, choosing one State/UT.
  3. Check your email from BFSI SSC: Candidates who applied on NATS receive an email from BFSI SSC ([email protected]) inviting them to provide caste category, choice of districts for training, and other details, and to pay the fee.
  4. Complete details and pay the fee: Submit the additional information and pay the online fee at beep.bfsissc.com by 29 October 2026. Details entered must match those on the NATS portal.
  5. Upload documents: Upload the photograph, signature, date of birth proof, graduation certificates and other certificates as required by the apprenticeship portal or when advised by the Bank or BFSI SSC.
  6. Appear for the online test: Take the test on 7 November 2026 using the link sent by email.

The candidate's name must be spelt exactly as in the certificates/mark sheets, percentage should be given to two decimals (CGPA must be converted to percentage), and no change is allowed after submission.

UCO Bank Apprentice Important Instructions

  • Candidates must have a valid personal email ID and mobile number, kept active until the engagement process is complete; call letters and intimations are sent by email/SMS only.
  • Original certificates for educational qualification, age and category must be produced at document verification, or candidature is cancelled.
  • OBC candidates need a non-creamy layer certificate issued on or after 1 April 2026; EWS candidates need an Income and Asset Certificate valid for FY 2026-27 (income of FY 2025-26); PwBD candidates need a disability certificate (UDID/certificates may be verified, and a medical board may reassess).
  • Apprentices are trainees, not employees; PF, ESI, bonus and other labour-law provisions do not apply, they may not join or form a union, and the Bank has no obligation to offer employment after training.
  • Candidates must execute a Contract of Apprenticeship before training begins; those who absent themselves may have to refund training costs and stipend received.
  • Travel costs for document verification are borne by the candidate. Requests for changes of contact details, address, email or test centre are not entertained.
  • Canvassing in any form is a disqualification. All disputes fall under the jurisdiction of the Courts at Kolkata.
  • All revisions and corrigenda will be published only on www.uco.bank.in (career section).

Ex-Servicemen (SC/ST) 13 years (5+5+3), after deducting military service rendered from actual age

Candidates seeking age relaxation must submit the requisite certificate from the competent authority, in the prescribed format, when sought by the Recruitment Board; otherwise their category claim will not be entertained and they will be considered under the General (UR) category. Date of Birth and Name as recorded in the Matriculation/Secondary Examination Certificate (or equivalent) alone will be accepted, with no scope for later change.

CRPF Sportsperson Recruitment 2026 Pay Scale

Post Pay Level (7th CPC)
Head Constable (GD) Sportspersons Level 4: Rs. 25,500 – 81,100
Constable (GD) Sportspersons Level 3: Rs. 21,700 – 69,100

Dearness Allowance, HRA and other allowances are admissible as per Government orders applicable in CRPF from time to time. The New Defined Contributory Pension Scheme (implemented vide MoF OM No. 1(7)(2)/2003/TA dated 07.01.2004) applies to selected candidates.

CRPF Sportsperson Recruitment 2026 Selection Process

Selection proceeds through Identity Check, Documentation, Physical Standard Test (PST), Sports Trial Test, and Detailed/Review Medical Examination, in sequence.

1. Documentation

All candidates undergo document verification, producing original documents/certificates relating to age, education, sports achievement, domicile and category. Candidates unable to produce the prescribed originals are eliminated at this stage; those qualified proceed to the PST.

2. Marking of Achievements (Merit List Basis)

Marks are awarded for the single highest medal/position achieved during the eligible window (30 September 2024 to 30 September 2026); if a candidate has more than one medal, only the highest-scoring one counts. Sample marking tiers:

Competition Level Gold Silver Bronze Participation
Olympic Games (Summer/Winter) 100 96 92 80
World Championship/World Cup 90 86 82 70
Asian/Commonwealth Games 80 76 72 60
Asian/Commonwealth Championship or Cup 70 66 62 50
Youth Olympic Games 60 56 52 40
Youth/Junior World Championship or Cup 55 51 47 35
Youth/Junior Asian & Commonwealth Championship 50 46 42 30
SAF Games / recognized International Competition (min. 7 countries, backed by a National-level medal) 40 36 32 26
National Games/Senior National Championship – Individual medal 30 26 22 12
National Games/Senior National Championship – Team event 26 22 18 8
Youth/Junior National Championship/Inter-University/Khelo India – Individual medal 20 16 12 6
Youth/Junior National Championship/Inter-University/Khelo India – Team event 16 12 8 4

3. Physical Standard Test (PST)

Standard Male Female
Height 170 cm 157 cm
Chest (male only) 80 cm unexpanded, min. 5 cm expansion —
Weight Proportionate to height and age, as per medical standards

Height/chest relaxations are available for several categories, including Scheduled Tribes (162.5/150 cm), ST candidates of North-Eastern States (157/147.5 cm), ST candidates of Left-Wing Extremism-affected districts (160/147.5 cm), Garhwalis/Kumaonis/Dogras/Marathas and candidates from Assam, Himachal Pradesh, J&K and Ladakh (165/155 cm), candidates from the North-Eastern States of Arunachal Pradesh, Manipur, Meghalaya, Mizoram, Nagaland, Sikkim and Tripura (162.5/152.5 cm), and candidates from the Gorkha Territorial Administration area of Darjeeling district (157/152.5 cm), with corresponding chest relaxations for male candidates in several of these categories.

4. Sports Trial Test

Candidates who qualify the PST undergo the Sports Trial Test, conducted by a Board of Officers. This test is purely qualifying (pass/fail) – no marks are awarded, and total marks for the merit list come only from the achievement marking scheme above. Candidates may be subjected to a Dope Test on the day of the trial; no appeal for re-conduct of the trial test is entertained.

5. Detailed Medical Examination (DME) & Review Medical Examination (RME)

Conducted per the Uniform Guidelines for Recruitment Medical Examination for GOs and NGOs in CAPFs and AR (MHA U.O. No. A.VI-1/2014-Rectt(SSB) dated 20.05.2015 and MHA OM No. E.32012/ADG(Med)/DME/RME/DA-1/2020(Part file)/1166 dated 31.05.2021, as amended). Minimum distance vision required is 6/6 and 6/9 in both eyes without correction; colour-blind candidates are not eligible; candidates must not have knock knee, flat foot, varicose veins or squint. Tattoos are restricted in content (secular/religious symbols only, as per Indian Army norms), location (left forearm inner aspect or dorsum of hands only) and size (less than ¼ of that body part). Candidates declared unfit in DME may undergo RME.

Order of Preference (for Merit)

Where marks are comparable, preference follows this order: (a) International representation with Department of Sports clearance; (b) Senior/Junior National Championship representation with a medal (Senior preferred over Junior); (c) Inter-University/Khelo India University Games medal; (d) Khelo India Youth/Winter Games medal; (e) School National Games medal; (f) participation at levels (b)–(e) without a medal, in the same order.

How to Apply for CRPF Sportsperson Recruitment 2026

  1. Visit rect.crpf.gov.in and read the instructions carefully before filling the application.
  2. Create your profile and upload a copy of the certificate/document for your sports discipline, in support of your highest medal/position or highest level of participation, before applying – applications without this upload will be rejected during scrutiny.
  3. Fill the online application form and pay the application fee (where applicable) through the website only.
  4. Submit the application before 11 November 2026, 23:59 hrs.
  5. Use the correction window (12–14 November 2026) if you need to modify your submitted application.
Important: The application must be submitted ONLINE only; no offline application is accepted, and candidature of anyone submitting offline will be summarily rejected. Candidates serving in Government/Semi-Government departments must submit their application through their employer along with a No Objection Certificate (as per Annexure-A format) – applications without an NOC will not be accepted.

Documents Required (Original, at Document Verification)

  • Educational certificates, Sports certificates, Domicile and Caste certificates, etc.
  • Matriculation/10th class certificate, for verification of Date of Birth
  • OBC (NCL) Certificate (Annexure-F), SC/ST Certificate (Annexure-G), or EWS Certificate valid for 2026-27 (Annexure-H), as applicable – certificates in any other format are not accepted
  • Undertaking for OBC (NCL) reservation claim, as per Annexure-F
  • No Objection Certificate (Annexure-B), for candidates serving in Government service, produced at the time of physical document verification
  • Certificate for claiming height/chest relaxation (Annexure-I), if applicable
  • Four latest passport-size photographs, matching the one submitted with the application form

Important Conditions

  • Application Fee: Male candidates belonging to UR/OBC/EWS pay Rs. 100/- through the recruitment website; the fee is exempted for all female candidates and for SC/ST/Ex-Servicemen candidates. The fee is neither refunded nor adjusted against any other recruitment process, under any circumstances.
  • Selected candidates must submit a bond to serve the Force for a minimum of 3 years (or a specific period as prescribed), backed by an undertaking bond of Rs. 1,00,000/-, to promote sports in the Force, before they can resign for better employment elsewhere or on any other ground.
  • Posts carry All India service liability; selected candidates are liable to serve anywhere in India or abroad, and will be governed by the CRPF Act 1949 and Rules 1955.
  • CRPF reserves the right to modify, cancel, postpone, or reschedule any stage of the recruitment process, and to change the sequence of the recruitment procedure, without assigning any reason.
  • Submitting fabricated documents, or documents that have been tampered with, will lead to cancellation of candidature at any stage, including at the time of document verification or later.
  • The Board of Officers may also recommend cases of Outstanding Sportspersons who show excellent trial performance but require some relaxation in height/chest/weight for their sport, subject to approval by the Ministry of Home Affairs.

What Are State PSC Jobs?

State PSC jobs are government recruitment opportunities notified through State Public Service Commissions. These commissions recruit candidates for various posts and services under state government departments according to the rules applicable to each recruitment.

State PSC recruitment is not limited to State Civil Services examinations. Public Service Commissions may also recruit candidates for engineering, medical, teaching, agriculture, legal, scientific, technical, administrative and other departmental posts.

The posts available depend on vacancies reported by the respective state government departments and the recruitment notifications issued by the commission.

Popular Posts Recruited Through State PSCs

State Public Service Commissions recruit candidates for a wide range of government posts. Common recruitment categories may include:

  • State Civil Services
  • Administrative Services
  • Assistant Commissioner
  • Assistant Director
  • Assistant Professor
  • Lecturer
  • Medical Officer
  • Veterinary Officer
  • Assistant Engineer
  • Assistant Executive Engineer
  • Agriculture Officer
  • Food Safety Officer
  • Drug Inspector
  • Scientific Officer
  • Law Officer
  • Labour Officer
  • Revenue-related Posts
  • Technical Officers
  • Departmental Officers

The actual posts available vary by commission and recruitment notification.

PSC Jobs by Group (Group 1, 2, 2A, 4 & Others)

Several State Public Service Commissions including TNPSC, APPSC, and TSPSC classify recruitment into numbered "Groups" based on post seniority, pay scale, and administrative responsibility. Understanding these groups helps candidates identify which exam to prepare for based on their qualification and career goals.

Group Typical Posts Minimum Qualification Selection Stages
Group 1 Deputy Collector, DSP, Assistant Commissioner, District Registrar Bachelor's degree Prelims + Mains + Interview
Group 2 Assistant Section Officer, Tehsildar, Municipal Commissioner (Grade), Block Development Officer Bachelor's degree Prelims + Mains (some states include Interview)
Group 2A Junior Assistant, Bill Collector, Field Surveyor Bachelor's degree Written Exam (Certificate Verification)
Group 3 Various department Grade II/Non-Gazetted posts Varies by post Written Exam
Group 4 Junior Assistant, Typist, Steno-Typist, Bill Collector, Record Clerk, Village Administrative Officer (VAO) SSLC / 10th or 12th pass (varies by post) Single Written Exam (Certificate Verification)

Group numbering, post names, and minimum qualifications vary by state the table above reflects the common pattern used by TNPSC-style classification. Some states use different group labels or don't use numbered groups at all. Always confirm the exact group structure and eligibility on your state PSC's official notification.

Who Should Apply for Group 4?

Group 4 posts are typically entry-level government jobs open to candidates who have completed SSLC (10th) or Higher Secondary (12th), making them one of the most accessible and high-demand categories of PSC recruitment. These posts don't usually require a specific degree, have a single-stage written exam, and see some of the highest applicant volumes of any PSC exam due to the lower qualification bar and large number of annual vacancies.

State PSC Eligibility Criteria

There is no single eligibility rule for all State PSC jobs. Qualification, age limit, experience and other conditions differ depending on the commission and post.

Eligibility Criteria General Guidance
Educational Qualification Depends on the post and may include Diploma, Graduation, Engineering, Medicine, Law, Post Graduation or another prescribed qualification.
Age Limit Minimum and maximum age limits vary by commission and recruitment.
Age Relaxation Relaxation may be available to eligible categories according to the rules applicable to the recruitment.
State / Domicile Conditions State-specific eligibility, reservation, language or residency conditions may apply to certain recruitments.
Experience Some technical, teaching, specialist or senior posts require relevant professional experience.
Number of Attempts Attempt restrictions apply only where specifically prescribed for an examination or recruitment.

Important: Candidates should check the detailed recruitment notification before applying because eligibility conditions differ for every State PSC recruitment.

State PSC Selection Process

The State PSC selection process depends on the commission and the type of post. There is no single selection procedure followed for every PSC recruitment.

Depending on the recruitment, the selection process may include one or more of the following stages:

  • Preliminary Examination
  • Main Examination
  • Written Examination
  • Screening Test
  • Subject-specific Examination
  • Skill Test
  • Physical Test
  • Interview / Personality Test
  • Document Verification
  • Medical Examination

State Civil Services examinations may have Preliminary, Main and Interview stages, while technical, medical, teaching and departmental recruitment may follow a different selection process.

Always check the individual recruitment notification for the exact examination and selection procedure.

How to Apply for State PSC Jobs 2026

The application process differs slightly between commissions, but candidates can generally follow these steps:

  1. Find the required State PSC recruitment from the latest jobs table above.
  2. Open the detailed recruitment page.
  3. Check the post name, vacancies, qualification, age limit, application fee and important dates.
  4. Read the official recruitment notification carefully.
  5. Open the official application website or application link.
  6. Complete registration or One-Time Registration if required by the commission.
  7. Enter the required personal, educational and category details.
  8. Upload the prescribed photograph, signature and supporting documents.
  9. Pay the application fee if applicable.
  10. Review the application before final submission.
  11. Submit the application before the specified last date.
  12. Save or print the submitted application for future reference.

Candidates should submit applications only through the application method specified in the official notification.

State PSC Exam Pattern and Syllabus

There is no common exam pattern or syllabus for all State PSC recruitments.

State Civil Services examinations generally cover broader subjects such as General Studies and state-specific topics, while technical, medical, engineering, teaching and departmental recruitment may focus more heavily on subjects related to the post.

The following can differ between recruitments:

  • Number of papers
  • Objective or descriptive examination
  • Total marks
  • Exam duration
  • Negative marking
  • Minimum qualifying marks
  • Language requirements
  • Subject-specific syllabus
  • Interview or skill test requirements

Candidates should refer to the syllabus and exam pattern issued for the specific State PSC recruitment they are applying for.

State PSC Jobs vs UPSC Jobs

State Public Service Commissions and the Union Public Service Commission conduct different recruitment processes.

State PSC UPSC
Conducts recruitment for posts and services connected with the respective state. Conducts recruitment and examinations for various Union Government and All India Services posts.
Recruitment rules differ from one State PSC to another. Recruitment is conducted under the rules applicable to UPSC examinations and vacancies.
May recruit for State Civil Services, engineering, medical, teaching, technical and departmental posts. Conducts Civil Services Examination and various other recruitment examinations for Union Government posts.

Candidates looking for Union Government recruitment through UPSC can visit the UPSC Jobs page.

PSC vs PCS - What Is the Difference?

PSC stands for Public Service Commission. It refers to the constitutional commission responsible for conducting recruitment for various government posts and services within its jurisdiction.

PCS commonly refers to Provincial Civil Service or State Civil Services posts and examinations.

A State Public Service Commission may conduct a State Civil Services or PCS examination, but it can also conduct recruitment for many other positions such as Medical Officer, Assistant Engineer, Lecturer, Agriculture Officer and departmental posts.

Therefore, State PSC Jobs covers a broader range of recruitment than only PCS or State Civil Services examinations.

How to Choose the Right State PSC Recruitment

Before applying for a State PSC vacancy, candidates should compare the recruitment requirements with their qualification and preferences.

Check the following details:

  • Required educational qualification
  • Age limit
  • Category and reservation conditions
  • State or language requirements, if any
  • Number of vacancies
  • Pay scale or salary
  • Job location
  • Application fee
  • Selection process
  • Examination pattern
  • Application deadline

Apply only after confirming that you meet the eligibility conditions mentioned in the official recruitment notification.

State PSC Recruitment Updates You Should Check

A recruitment notification can sometimes be followed by additional notices from the commission. Candidates should continue checking recruitment updates even after submitting their application.

Important updates may include:

  • Application date extension
  • Correction window
  • Vacancy revision
  • Exam date
  • Exam city information
  • Admit card
  • Answer key
  • Result
  • Interview schedule
  • Document verification schedule
  • Final selection result

Relevant updates should be linked from the individual recruitment page whenever they are released.

For each recruitment, candidates can find important details such as:

Latest State PSC Notifications - Frequently Asked Questions

What are State PSC Jobs?

State PSC Jobs are government recruitment opportunities notified through State Public Service Commissions for various posts and services under state government departments.

Which State PSC jobs are currently open?

Currently open recruitments are listed in the Latest State PSC Jobs 2026 table at the top of this page. The list is updated when new recruitment notifications and application updates are released.

Where can I find the latest State PSC recruitment notifications?

You can check the latest State PSC recruitment notifications on this page or select your commission from the State-wise PSC Jobs section to find recruitment specific to your state.

What qualification is required for State PSC jobs?

There is no single qualification required for all State PSC jobs. Depending on the post, candidates may need a Diploma, Graduation, Engineering degree, Medical qualification, Law degree, Post Graduation or another specified qualification.

Are all State PSC jobs for graduates?

No. Eligibility depends on the individual recruitment. Many administrative posts require a degree, while technical, professional and departmental posts may have different qualification requirements.

What is the age limit for State PSC jobs?

The minimum and maximum age limits vary according to the commission and post. Candidates should check the age criteria given in the individual recruitment notification.

Is age relaxation available for State PSC recruitment?

Age relaxation may be available to eligible categories according to the rules applicable to the respective recruitment. The exact relaxation should be checked in the official notification.

Is domicile compulsory for State PSC jobs?

Not for every State PSC recruitment. Some vacancies may have state-specific residency, reservation, language or other eligibility requirements. Candidates should check the relevant recruitment rules before applying.

What is the selection process for State PSC jobs?

The selection process varies by post. It may include a Preliminary Examination, Main Examination, written test, screening test, skill test, interview, physical test, document verification or medical examination.

Do all State PSC recruitments have Prelims and Mains?

No. Prelims and Mains are common in some State Civil Services examinations, but many technical, medical, teaching and departmental recruitments follow a different examination or selection process.

How can I apply for State PSC recruitment?

Open the required recruitment from the latest jobs table, read the eligibility and application details, check the official notification and use the official application link provided on the recruitment page.

What is the difference between State PSC and UPSC?

State PSCs conduct recruitment mainly for posts and services connected with their respective states, while UPSC conducts recruitment and examinations for various Union Government and All India Services posts.

Is PSC the same as PCS?

No. PSC means Public Service Commission, while PCS generally refers to Provincial Civil Service or State Civil Services. A State PSC can recruit for PCS as well as many other administrative, technical, medical and departmental posts.

Where can I check State PSC admit cards?

When an admit card is released, the related recruitment page should be updated with the admit card information and official download link. Candidates can also check the OnlyJobs Admit Card section.

Where can I check State PSC results?

State PSC result updates can be checked through the individual recruitment page or the OnlyJobs Results section.

How often is this State PSC Jobs page updated?

The page is updated when new State PSC recruitment notifications, application extensions and other important recruitment updates become available.

What Is a Bharat Sarkari Job?

A Bharat Sarkari Job is any government job opportunity offered across India's central and state government departments - spanning all 28 states and 8 union territories. The term "Bharat" simply emphasises pan-India coverage: a Bharat Sarkari Job notification could originate from a central body like the SSC, UPSC, or Indian Railways, or from a state public service commission recruiting for state-level posts. Regardless of origin, these roles share the defining traits Indian aspirants seek - long-term job security, government pay scales, and statutory retirement benefits.

Sarkari Job vs Private Job

A sarkari job differs from private-sector employment in a few important ways: government positions are governed by service rules that protect against arbitrary termination, salaries follow Pay Commission recommendations rather than market negotiation, and employees are entitled to pension schemes (NPS or OPS depending on recruitment year), medical coverage under CGHS, and fixed working hours. Private jobs, by contrast, often offer higher starting pay in competitive fields but carry less structural job security.

सरकारी फॉर्म ऑनलाइन 2026 कैसे भरें? (How to Apply Online)

हर साल लाखों उम्मीदवार सरकारी फॉर्म ऑनलाइन 2026 भरने की प्रक्रिया में गलतियाँ कर बैठते हैं, जिससे उनका आवेदन रद्द हो सकता है। नीचे दी गई सरल प्रक्रिया से आप अपना फॉर्म सही तरीके से भर सकते हैं।

आवेदन की चरणबद्ध प्रक्रिया

  1. संबंधित विभाग की आधिकारिक अधिसूचना (Notification PDF) ध्यान से पढ़ें और अपनी पात्रता जांचें।
  2. वैध ईमेल आईडी और मोबाइल नंबर से पोर्टल पर पंजीकरण (Registration) करें।
  3. व्यक्तिगत विवरण, शैक्षणिक योग्यता, और आवश्यक दस्तावेज़ अपलोड करें (फोटो, हस्ताक्षर, प्रमाणपत्र)।
  4. निर्धारित आवेदन शुल्क का ऑनलाइन भुगतान करें और भुगतान की रसीद सुरक्षित रखें।
  5. फॉर्म सबमिट करने से पहले सभी जानकारी की दोबारा जांच करें और फॉर्म का प्रिंटआउट अवश्य लें।

Documents Required for Sarkari Form

Typical documents needed: recent passport-size photograph (as per specified size/format), scanned signature, educational certificates and mark sheets, category certificate (if applicable), and a valid ID proof (Aadhaar/PAN).

Common Mistakes to Avoid While Applying

  • Submitting a photo or signature that doesn't match the specified pixel/size requirements.
  • Missing the last date due to server load - apply at least 2–3 days before deadline.
  • Entering a name or date of birth that doesn't match your certificates exactly.
  • Forgetting to download and save the final submitted form and payment receipt.

  1. Find the latest Supervisor recruitment advertisement for your state.

How to Apply for Anganwadi Recruitment 2026

Candidates can submit the Anganwadi Form 2026 online or offline according to the instructions in the specific recruitment advertisement. There is no single online application process for every state.

  1. Choose your state, district and post from the recruitment list.
  2. Open the detailed notification and verify the last date.
  3. Confirm your qualification, age and local residence eligibility.
  4. Follow the official online application link or obtain the prescribed offline form.
  5. Complete the required information and submit the specified documents.
  6. Pay the application fee only if required by the notification.
  7. Submit before the closing deadline and retain the acknowledgement or submission record where provided.

Documents for Anganwadi Online or Offline Application

Depending on the notification, applicants may need proof of educational qualification, age, local residence, category and identity. Photograph, signature and other supporting certificates should be prepared in the format prescribed by the authority. The exact document list must be checked before applying.

Anganwadi Recruitment 2026 FAQs

What is the last date for Anganwadi Recruitment 2026?

There is no common last date for Anganwadi Recruitment 2026. Each state or district publishes its own closing date. Check the live recruitment table for the applicable notification.

Where can I apply for Anganwadi jobs online in 2026?

Apply through the official state or district recruitment portal mentioned in the specific advertisement. Some Anganwadi recruitments require offline applications instead.

Is Anganwadi Supervisor Vacancy 2026 available?

Supervisor vacancies are announced separately by the relevant recruitment authorities. Candidates should confirm an active Supervisor notification before applying.

What is the last date for Anganwadi Supervisor Vacancy 2026?

The last date depends on the state and the Supervisor advertisement. Worker and Helper application deadlines do not automatically apply to Supervisor posts.

Can 10th or 12th pass candidates apply for Anganwadi jobs?

Yes, some Anganwadi Worker and Helper notifications accept Class 10 or Class 12 qualifications. The required qualification depends on the post and recruiting authority.

Is there an examination for Anganwadi Recruitment 2026?

The selection method depends on the official notification. Candidates should check whether the recruitment involves academic merit, a written examination, interview or other prescribed stages.

How can I find Anganwadi Vacancy 2026 in Haryana or Telangana?

Check the state-wise recruitment section and open the relevant district notification. Verify the post, vacancy, deadline and application mode before applying.

Where can I find Anganwadi Recruitment 2026 in Maharashtra?

Check the relevant Maharashtra Women and Child Development or district recruitment notification for Anganwadi Sevika, Helper and Supervisor vacancies, as applicable.

Is wcd.gov.in the Anganwadi Recruitment 2026 official website?

The central Ministry of Women and Child Development website is wcd.gov.in. Recruitment application portals differ by state and district, so applicants must use the portal specified in their notification.

Can I apply for an Anganwadi vacancy in another district?

That depends on the recruitment's residence and eligibility rules. Some Worker and Helper notices require candidates to belong to a particular village, ward or project area.

Forest Guard Recruitment 2026 - Latest Vacancies & Eligibility

Forest Guard recruitment is suitable for candidates interested in forest protection, patrolling and field-level government work. Forest Guard vacancies are generally announced by state forest departments or authorized recruitment boards.

What does a Forest Guard do?

A Forest Guard helps protect forest areas, monitor activities, assist with wildlife conservation and report suspected forest offences. Duties can include patrolling assigned forest areas and supporting senior forest officials.

What is the qualification for Forest Guard Recruitment 2026?

Some Forest Guard recruitments require Class 10 or Class 12 qualifications from a recognized board. However, the exact educational requirements depend on the state and recruitment notification.

Candidates should check:

  • Education: Required qualification and recognized board.
  • Age Limit: Minimum and maximum age, including the age-calculation date.
  • Physical Standards: Height, chest measurements or other applicable requirements.
  • Selection Process: Written examination, physical tests or other notified stages.
  • Vacancies: Total and category-wise posts.
  • Application Dates: Registration opening and closing dates.

How can I apply for Forest Guard Vacancy 2026?

Find the Forest Guard recruitment in the vacancy table above, open the detailed notification, confirm eligibility and follow the official application instructions.

Candidates should apply only through the website or submission method prescribed by the recruiting authority.

Forest Range Officer Recruitment 2026 - RFO Jobs

Forest Range Officer Recruitment 2026 provides opportunities for candidates interested in forest administration, conservation and supervisory roles.

A Forest Range Officer, also referred to as a Range Forest Officer or RFO in some recruitment systems, may oversee forest protection activities, supervise field staff and manage responsibilities within an assigned forest range.

What is the qualification for Forest Range Officer recruitment?

Forest Range Officer recruitment generally involves graduate-level eligibility. Some notifications require degrees in specified subjects such as science, agriculture, forestry or other approved disciplines.

The accepted qualifications vary by recruiting organization. A graduation degree alone does not automatically make a candidate eligible for every RFO vacancy.

How are Forest Range Officers selected?

Depending on the recruitment rules, selection may include:

  • Preliminary or main written examinations
  • Physical standards or fitness assessments
  • Interviews, where prescribed
  • Document verification
  • Medical examination

Candidates searching for RFO Vacancy 2026, Forest Ranger Recruitment or Forest Range Service Officer notifications should check the relevant vacancy details for exact eligibility and selection stages.

Forest Department Jobs List - Popular Posts

Forest-related government jobs include field protection, administration, conservation, research and technical positions.

Post Main Work
Forest Guard Forest protection, patrolling and monitoring
Forest Watcher Supporting forest monitoring and protection
Forester Supervising field operations and forest staff
Forest Beat Officer Managing assigned beat-level field duties
Forest Range Officer (RFO) Supervising and administering a forest range
Assistant Conservator of Forests (ACF) Forest administration and management
Indian Forest Service (IFoS) Officer Forest service administration and conservation
Technical and Research Staff Forestry research, laboratories and specialist work
Clerical and Support Staff Administrative and office-related duties

Which Forest Department post should you apply for? Choose a post based on your educational qualification, age, physical eligibility, preferred work and the conditions specified in the official notification.

The availability of these posts varies by recruitment cycle and state.

State-Wise Forest Department Recruitment 2026

Forest Department recruitment is conducted separately by different states and recruiting agencies. Candidates should check their preferred state's notifications because job availability, eligibility rules and application deadlines may differ.

The table above lists the types of vacancies candidates may encounter; it does not confirm that these recruitments are currently open.

For currently available jobs and application deadlines, use the main recruitment table at the top of this page.

Where can I find Forest Department jobs in my state?

Identify your state in the recruiting organization's name or recruitment details. Open the applicable notification to check the job location, state eligibility requirements, reservation rules and official application website.

Forest Department Recruitment 2026 - Eligibility Criteria

Eligibility for Forest Department jobs depends on the post, department and recruitment rules.

Educational Qualification

Post Category Common Qualification Pattern
Forest Guard / Forest Watcher Some recruitments accept Class 10 or Class 12
Forester School-level or higher qualifications, as notified
Forest Beat Officer Qualification specified by the recruiting board
Forest Range Officer Usually a degree, sometimes in specified subjects
Assistant Conservator of Forests Degree requirements under the relevant service rules
Technical and Research Posts Relevant diploma, degree or specialized qualification
Clerical and Support Posts Post-specific educational and skill requirements

These are general patterns, not fixed nationwide eligibility criteria.

What is the age limit for Forest Department jobs?

There is no common age limit for all Forest Department recruitment in India.

Each notification specifies the minimum age, maximum age, applicable cut-off date and age-relaxation rules.

Candidates belonging to reserved categories, including eligible ex-servicemen, should check the provisions applicable to their recruitment.

Is a physical test compulsory for Forest Department jobs?

Physical standards and fitness assessments are common in certain field-level posts, particularly Forest Guard and some officer-level recruitment.

However, not every Forest Department post has a physical test. Technical, administrative and other positions may follow different selection procedures.

Where physical testing is required, the official notification specifies the standards, test format and qualifying conditions.

Forest Department Recruitment 2026 - Important Dates & Last Date

What is the last date to apply for Forest Department Recruitment 2026?

There is no single closing date for every Forest Department vacancy. Application deadlines are set separately by the recruiting authorities.

Check the latest recruitment table for the last date of each available notification.

Important dates may include:

  • Notification release date
  • Application start date
  • Application closing date
  • Last date for fee payment
  • Form correction dates, if available
  • Examination date
  • Admit card release date
  • Result announcement

Before applying: Confirm the closing date and time zone, if specified, in the official notification. Do not assume that a registration deadline has been extended unless the recruiting authority confirms it.

How to Apply for Forest Department Recruitment 2026

Candidates can apply online or offline according to the instructions issued for the specific vacancy.

Application process

  1. Choose a vacancy: Find a suitable Forest Department job in the recruitment table.
  2. Check eligibility: Verify the qualification, age limit, physical requirements and other conditions.
  3. Read the notification: Review the official recruitment PDF and important instructions.
  4. Open the application link: Visit the authorized recruitment portal or follow the offline application procedure.
  5. Complete the form: Enter the required personal, educational and contact details.
  6. Submit documents: Upload or attach the prescribed certificates and photographs.
  7. Pay the fee: Complete payment if the notification requires an application fee.
  8. Submit the application: Review the details and complete submission before the deadline.
  9. Save confirmation: Keep the acknowledgment or completed application for future reference.

Which documents are required?

The required documents vary by recruitment. Applicants may need educational certificates, identity proof, photograph, signature, category certificates, domicile documents or other eligibility records.

Always follow the document list and format requirements mentioned in the official notification.

Forest Department Selection Process 2026

How are candidates selected for Forest Department jobs?

Recruiting organizations use different selection methods based on the post. Some Forest Guard and officer-level vacancies include written examinations and physical tests, while technical or administrative roles may involve skill tests or interviews.

Selection Stage What Candidates Should Know
Written Examination Tests knowledge or skills specified in the official syllabus
Physical Standard Test (PST) Checks prescribed physical measurements
Physical Efficiency Test (PET) Assesses fitness through notified activities
Skill Test / Interview Conducted when required for the position
Document Verification Confirms qualifications and eligibility documents
Medical Examination Checks medical fitness where prescribed

Not every candidate will undergo every stage. The official recruitment notice determines the actual selection procedure and the basis for preparing the merit list.

What is the Forest Guard exam syllabus?

Where a written examination is required, the syllabus may cover General Knowledge, Current Affairs, General Science, Mathematics, Reasoning, environmental topics or state-specific subjects.

Candidates should follow the syllabus and examination pattern published for their particular Forest Guard or Forest Range Officer recruitment.

Forest Department Jobs Salary 2026

How much salary do Forest Department employees receive?

Forest Department salaries depend on the post, state, pay scale, appointment category and service rules.

For example, a Forest Guard's pay may differ from that of a Forester, Range Forest Officer or Assistant Conservator of Forests.

Post Pay Level / Pay Scale Approximate Gross Salary (Monthly)
Forest Guard / Field Guard Pay Level 3 ₹28,000 – ₹35,000
Forester Pay Level 4–5 ₹35,000 – ₹45,000
Range Forest Officer Pay Level 7–8 ₹50,000 – ₹65,000
Assistant Conservator of Forests (ACF) Pay Level 10 ₹70,000 – ₹95,000
Indian Forest Service (IFS) Officer Pay Level 10 and above ₹80,000+ (with allowances)

Regular positions may carry a prescribed pay level and allowances, while contractual or project-based posts may offer fixed monthly remuneration.

Before applying, check:

  • Basic pay or consolidated remuneration
  • Pay level and salary scale
  • Applicable allowances
  • Probation or contract terms
  • Other service conditions

The official recruitment notification is the correct source for the salary of a specific vacancy.

Forest Department Recruitment 2026 - Official Notification & Application Website

There is no single national application website for all state Forest Department jobs.

Recruitment may be handled by a state Forest Department, Public Service Commission, staff selection board or another authorized organization.

To locate the correct official website:

  1. Find your preferred vacancy in the recruitment table.
  2. Open its detailed job notification.
  3. Check the name of the recruiting authority.
  4. Open the official notification PDF.
  5. Follow the application link or instructions provided by the recruiting authority.

OnlyJobs publishes recruitment information to help candidates find opportunities. The official recruiting organization remains the authoritative source for eligibility, deadlines, results and application procedures.

Van Vibhag Bharti 2026 - वन विभाग भर्ती

Van Vibhag Bharti 2026 (वन विभाग भर्ती 2026) refers to Forest Department recruitment.

Candidates looking for वन विभाग वैकेंसी 2026, वन रक्षक भर्ती, Forest Guard Bharti or वन विभाग ऑनलाइन फॉर्म can use the recruitment list above to find relevant notifications.

वन विभाग भर्ती 2026 के लिए आवेदन कैसे करें?

उम्मीदवार ऊपर दी गई भर्ती सूची में संबंधित पद चुनकर योग्यता, आयु सीमा, आवेदन की अंतिम तिथि और आधिकारिक नोटिफिकेशन देख सकते हैं। आवेदन करने से पहले संबंधित विभाग की आधिकारिक अधिसूचना पढ़ें।

Forest Department Recruitment 2026 - Frequently Asked Questions

1. Is Forest Department Recruitment 2026 open?

Forest-related vacancies are announced throughout the year by different recruiting organizations. Check the latest vacancy table above for the status of individual recruitments. An advertised post should be considered open only within its confirmed application period.

2. What is the last date for Forest Department Recruitment 2026?

The last date differs for each recruitment. Check the applicable notification's closing date in the table and verify it against the official announcement.

3. How can I apply for Forest Guard Recruitment 2026?

Find an applicable Forest Guard vacancy, review the educational and physical requirements, and follow the official application instructions before the closing date.

4. Can 10th-pass candidates apply for Forest Department jobs?

Some Forest Guard, Forest Watcher and support recruitments may accept Class 10 qualifications. Eligibility depends on the post and recruiting authority.

5. Can 12th-pass candidates apply for Forest Guard vacancies?

Yes, some Forest Guard recruitments accept Class 12 qualifications. Check the specific notification to confirm any subject or additional eligibility requirements.

6. Can graduates apply for Forest Range Officer recruitment?

Graduates may qualify for certain Forest Range Officer vacancies, but some recruitments require degrees in specified disciplines. Candidates must verify the accepted qualifications.

7. Is a physical test required for Forest Guard recruitment?

Many Forest Guard recruitments include physical standards or fitness tests. The exact requirements depend on the recruiting authority.

8. What is the age limit for Forest Guard recruitment?

The age limit varies by state and notification. Check the official minimum and maximum ages, cut-off date and applicable relaxations.

9. Is there an exam for Forest Department jobs?

Many Forest Guard, Forester and officer-level recruitments include written examinations. Other roles may use different selection methods. Follow the official selection process for the chosen vacancy.

10. What is the difference between a Forest Guard and a Forest Range Officer?

A Forest Guard generally performs field-level protection and monitoring duties. A Forest Range Officer usually carries supervisory and administrative responsibilities for a forest range. Exact duties differ under the relevant service rules.

11. Can ex-servicemen apply for Forest Department recruitment?

Eligible ex-servicemen can apply for vacancies where they meet the recruitment requirements. Reservation benefits and relaxations depend on the applicable rules.

12. Are Forest Department jobs available in every state?

Different states announce vacancies at different times. Not every state or post necessarily has an active recruitment notification at any given moment.

13. Is there a single apply online link for all Forest Department vacancies?

No. Each recruiting organization may use a different application portal or offline application process.

14. Where can I download the official Forest Department notification PDF?

Open the relevant recruitment from the latest vacancy table and follow its official notification link.

Note: Apprenticeship posts (under the Apprentices Act) are not regular government jobs but are a popular no-exam entry route into PSUs and railways for ITI/diploma/graduate candidates, offering valuable hands-on experience.

Two Types of No Exam Govt Jobs

No-exam recruitment in India falls into two patterns, and knowing which one a notification belongs to tells you exactly what to prepare for:

Type Typical Posts Who it's for How Selection Works
Fresher - no exam, usually no interview Apprentice, GDS, trainee 10th/12th/ITI/Diploma/Graduate pass Merit list prepared from academic marks
Experienced - no exam, interview-based Officer, manager, specialist, medical Professionals with relevant work experience Shortlisting based on qualification/experience, followed by a personal interview

How Recruitment Without Exam Works in Government Jobs

This section explains the different routes through which government departments fill vacancies without conducting a written competitive exam.

1. Direct Recruitment

Certain senior and specialised posts - such as Chairman, Member, and Secretary in Union Public Service Commission (UPSC) and State Public Service Commissions (PSCs) - are filled through direct recruitment based on eligibility criteria like qualifications, experience, and domain expertise, rather than a written exam. Similarly, some administrative posts in the Ministry of External Affairs (MEA) may be filled through direct recruitment.

2. Sports Quota Recruitment

Government organisations such as Indian Railways, the Indian Army, and Public Sector Banks reserve a quota of posts for candidates with outstanding achievements in sports at the state, national, or international level. Eligible candidates can be appointed to posts like Assistant Station Master, Ticket Collector, and Clerk without going through the regular written exam.

3. Cultural Quota Recruitment

Indian Railways also recruits individuals with exceptional talent in arts, fine arts, music, or literature under the cultural quota for posts such as Junior Clerk, Ticket Collector, and Assistant Loco Pilot.

4. Internal Promotions and Deputation

Government departments, including the Indian Administrative Service (IAS) and Indian Police Service (IPS), promote existing employees to higher posts based on performance, seniority, and experience - without requiring them to clear a fresh competitive exam. Ex-servicemen and defence personnel are also often considered for civilian government posts through deputation or reservation quotas, without a written exam.

5. Apprenticeships and Trainee Programmes

Railways, PSUs, and central organisations like DRDO and BEL regularly hire Act Apprentices, Trade Apprentices, and Project Trainees through merit lists based on academic marks - with no written entrance test.

6. Walk-in Interviews

Some government and PSU organisations directly call candidates for walk-in interviews based on their qualifications and experience, especially for technical, medical, and contractual roles.

Government Jobs Without Exam by Sector

This section breaks down no-exam opportunities by sector - banking and railways - which are among the most common areas where such recruitment occurs.

Bank Jobs Without Exam

While most public sector bank recruitment (PO, Clerk, SO) happens through IBPS or bank-specific written exams, some banks fill specific posts - such as Local Bank Officer and certain Specialist Officer roles - through direct recruitment, where the bank shortlists applications based on eligibility criteria and conducts an interview instead of a written test.

Railway Jobs Without Exam

Indian Railways and the various Railway Recruitment Boards/Cells (RRBs/RRCs) offer no-exam entry through:

  • Act Apprentices (selection via academic merit list)
  • Sports Quota posts (Assistant Station Master, Ticket Collector, Clerk)
  • Cultural Quota posts (Junior Clerk, Ticket Collector, Assistant Loco Pilot)
  • Scouts and Guides Quota

Before You Apply: How to Spot Fake "No Exam" Job Offers

No-exam recruitment is the single biggest magnet for job fraud in India, because "direct joining, no exam" is exactly what scammers promise. Four rules protect you:

  1. No genuine government post is ever sold. Nobody - agent, "officer", consultancy - can arrange selection for money. The only payment in real recruitment is the application fee, paid on the official portal, typically a few hundred rupees.
  2. Verify the notification on the official domain. Every real notice lives on a .gov.in, .nic.in or official PSU domain. Every row in our list links to the post page where the official notification PDF and apply link are attached - if an offer you received isn't traceable to an official notice, treat it as fraud.
  3. No recruitment happens over WhatsApp or Telegram DMs. Forwarded "joining letters" and interview calls demanding a deposit are scams, full stop.
  4. Cross-check suspicious notices against PIB Fact Check before sharing or paying anything.

How to Apply for Government Jobs Without Exam

  1. Open the post from the live list and read the official notification PDF - eligibility, age limits and fee are final there, not in any summary.
  2. Confirm you match the qualification and category requirements before paying any fee.
  3. Apply on the official portal linked in the notification; keep the registration number and fee receipt.
  4. For merit-list posts (GDS, apprentice), enter marks exactly as on your certificates - mismatches reject applications at verification.
  5. Track the post page for merit list / shortlist updates, or subscribe to WhatsApp/Telegram alerts so deadlines and results reach you automatically.

Government Jobs Without Exam - FAQs

1. Are there really government jobs without an exam?

Yes. Apprenticeship intakes, India Post GDS, sports and cultural quota posts, walk-in interviews and direct recruitment for experienced candidates are all filled without a written competitive exam. The live list at the top of this page shows every such notification currently open.

2. Which government jobs have no exam and no interview at all?

India Post GDS and Railway/PSU Act Apprentice selections use only a merit list of academic marks - there is no written test and no interview. Everything depends on your Class 10 (and ITI/diploma, where applicable) percentage.

3. What no-exam options exist for freshers after 10th, 12th or ITI?

Apprenticeships, GDS and trainee posts are the main fresher routes. Selection is a merit list prepared from academic marks, which is why these notifications attract very high application volumes despite no exam.

4. Can experienced professionals get a government job without an exam?

Yes. PSUs and autonomous bodies fill officer, manager and specialist posts by shortlisting candidates on qualification and experience, followed by a personal interview - no written test.

5. Are government jobs without exam permanent?

Often not. Apprenticeships are roughly one-year training engagements with a stipend, and many walk-in posts are contractual with fixed tenure. Direct-recruitment posts can be regular - the notification states the nature of each post, so check before applying.

6. Are there bank jobs without an exam?

A few. Some banks fill specialist and local officer posts through shortlisting plus interview. Bank apprenticeship drives vary - some are merit-based while others include an online test - so read each notification's selection clause.

7. Are there railway jobs without an exam?

Yes: Act Apprentice intakes (merit list), sports quota, cultural quota and Scouts & Guides quota. Apprentice intakes are large; the quota routes are small zonal recruitments with their own assessment process.

8. Is India Post GDS really without an exam?

Yes - selection is an online merit list generated from Class 10 marks, with no exam and no interview. Because of that, GDS is heavily targeted by paid-selection scams; apply only through the official GDS portal.

9. How do I identify fake "no exam" job offers?

No genuine government post is sold, fees are paid only on official portals, and no recruitment happens over WhatsApp or Telegram messages. Verify every offer against the official notification on a government or PSU domain - if it isn't there, it's fraud.

10. How often is this list updated?

Daily. New notifications are added as they release, and every listing is removed automatically after its last date, so the list only ever shows posts you can still apply for.

Govt Jobs for Law Graduates - Eligibility (LLB, LLM, BL)

Eligibility varies by post, but the core requirement for almost every government law job is a recognised law degree. Senior and specialised roles add experience, an LLM, or Bar enrolment on top.

Educational Qualification

  • Bachelor of Law (BL) / LLB (Legum Baccalaureus): the baseline qualification for most legal and law officer posts.
  • LLM (Master of Laws): required for senior legal officer, faculty, and some advisory positions.
  • Integrated 5-year degrees - BA LLB, BBA LLB, BCom LLB - are accepted wherever an LLB is required.

The degree must be from a university recognised by the Bar Council of India.

Bar Council Enrolment & AIBE

For litigation, prosecutor, and standing-counsel roles you generally need to be enrolled as an advocate with a State Bar Council, and many positions ask for the All India Bar Examination (AIBE) Certificate of Practice issued by the Bar Council of India. Purely advisory or research posts (Law Clerk, Research Fellow, Legal Consultant) often do not require enrolment.

Age Limit & Relaxations

The upper age limit is typically 30 to 40 years for the general category, depending on the post and recruiter. Statutory relaxations apply: usually 3 years for OBC, 5 years for SC/ST, and additional relaxation for PwD and ex-servicemen candidates. Always confirm the exact limit and cut-off date in the official notification, as judicial-service and PSU limits differ.

Salary & Pay Scale for Government Law Jobs

Pay depends on the organisation and grade. Officer-level legal posts under the 7th Pay Commission generally fall in Pay Levels 10 to 12, with a monthly salary roughly between ₹56,100 and ₹1,77,500, plus Dearness Allowance, House Rent Allowance, and other benefits. PSU legal officers are paid on IDA scales, which can be higher at entry grade.

Types of Law Officer / Legal Posts in Government Sector

  • Judicial Services - Civil Judge (Junior Division), Additional District Judge, High Court Judge, recruited via State Judicial Service Exams (PCS-J)
  • Law Officer / Legal Officer - Roles in public sector banks (IBPS SO Law), insurance companies (LIC AAO Legal), regulatory bodies (SEBI Grade A Legal), and PSUs (Coal India, NTPC, GAIL Legal)
  • Legal Assistant & Legal Advisor - Administrative legal support roles in ministries, universities, and district courts
  • Assistant Public Prosecutor (APO) - Prosecution roles recruited through State PSCs, requiring LLB and often a minimum years of practice

Judicial Services (Civil Judge, ADJ, High Court Judge)

Judicial Services is the most prestigious and highest-paying career path for LLB graduates. Recruitment happens through State Public Service Commissions (e.g., RPSC, UPPSC, MPPSC) via a three-stage exam: Preliminary, Mains, and Interview. Civil Judge posts typically require 0-3 years of practice depending on the state, while some states allow fresh LLB graduates to apply directly.

Law Officer / Legal Officer (Banks, PSU, Insurance)

Public sector banks and insurance companies recruit Law Officers through specialist officer (SO) exams. These posts require only an LLB degree (AIBE not mandatory) and offer competitive pay scales under the 7th Pay Commission equivalent structure, along with allowances.

Legal Assistant & Legal Advisor Posts

These are typically Group B/C administrative-legal posts in ministries, universities, and PSU legal departments, requiring an LLB degree and sometimes relevant drafting/litigation experience.

Assistant Public Prosecutor (APO)

APO recruitment is conducted by State PSCs (e.g., RPSC Assistant Prosecution Officer) and requires an LLB degree, enrollment as an advocate, and in most states, a minimum period of practice (often 3 years).

Selection Process for Law Govt Jobs

The selection process differs by post but commonly includes:

  1. Written examination - testing legal knowledge, aptitude, and general awareness (for judicial services and most exam-based posts).
  2. Interview / viva-voce - assessing legal reasoning and suitability.
  3. Document verification - degree, Bar enrolment, AIBE, age, and category certificates.

Advisory and consultant posts are often filled by shortlisting and interview alone, without a written exam.

Law Govt Jobs FAQ's

What are the latest law govt jobs in 2026?

Current law government jobs in 2026 include Law Officer, Legal Officer, Assistant Prosecution Officer, Judicial Service, and Legal Adviser posts across High Courts, PSUs, public sector banks, and central/state departments. The table above is updated daily with vacancy count, last date, and the official notification link.

Which departments hire LLB and law graduates?

High Courts and District Courts, the Ministry of Law and Justice, UPSC, State Public Service Commissions, public sector banks, PSUs, insurance companies, and regulatory bodies regularly recruit law graduates for legal and judicial roles.

What is the eligibility for government law jobs?

Most posts require a Bachelor of Law (LLB/BL) from a recognised university; senior roles may require LLM and experience. Litigation and prosecutor posts usually require enrolment with a State Bar Council and, often, the AIBE certificate.

What is the salary of a Law Officer in the government sector?

A government Law Officer or Legal Officer typically earns between ₹56,100 and ₹1,77,500 per month under the 7th Pay Commission, depending on the organisation, plus DA, HRA, and allowances. PSU legal officers draw IDA-scale pay.

Can a fresher LLB graduate get a government job?

Yes. Freshers can apply for Civil Judge (Junior Division) judicial-service exams, Law Clerk and Research Fellow posts in High Courts, and trainee legal roles. Some PSU and bank Law Officer posts require a few years of post-enrolment experience.

How can I apply for law officer vacancies in central government?

Open the post in the table above, read the official notification, register on the recruiter's portal, fill in the application with your LLB and enrolment details, pay the fee, and submit before the last date.

What is the difference between Judicial Services and Law Officer posts

Judicial Services (Civil Judge, via state judiciary exams) places you on the bench as a judge. Law Officer/Legal Officer posts are departmental legal-counsel roles in PSUs, banks, and ministries - advisory and litigation support, recruited by interview or written test.

Is there an age limit for govt law jobs?

Most posts set the upper age at 30 to 40 years for the general category, with statutory relaxations for OBC, SC/ST, and PwD candidates. Check each notification, as judicial-service and PSU limits differ.

Is RBI Exam Calendar 2027 Final or Tentative?

The published RBI Recruitment Calendar 2027 is tentative and indicative.

It specifies recruitment and examination months rather than exact dates.

The calendar states that recruitment decisions, notification months and examination schedules may be altered if circumstances require.

The detailed recruitment advertisement issued for each post will be the authoritative source for eligibility conditions, vacancies, final dates and other terms.

RBI Grade B Selection Process 2027

The RBI Grade B (DR) recruitment process generally includes three stages, subject to the applicable recruitment stream and final notification:

  1. Phase I: Initial online examination.
  2. Phase II: Main examination for candidates qualifying the applicable first stage.
  3. Interview: Final interview or assessment stage under the relevant recruitment rules.

The examination structure differs between the General, DEPR and DSIM streams. Candidates should follow their stream-specific advertisement.

How to Prepare for RBI Exams 2027?

With the month-wise recruitment calendar available, candidates can use the tentative schedule to organise their preparation.

  • Identify the recruitment and discipline relevant to your qualification.
  • Check the syllabus and exam pattern from the most recent applicable official notification.
  • Prepare the common aptitude and general awareness sections where prescribed.
  • For Grade B General, revise Economic and Social Issues, Finance and Management, and English writing skills according to the prescribed syllabus.
  • For DEPR, DSIM and specialist posts, focus on the relevant subject knowledge.
  • Practise previous examination papers and timed mock tests.
  • Monitor the official website for the detailed notification, syllabus and final exam dates.

Interested candidates can apply using the relevant careers listing or send their resume as instructed.

The detailed Customer Service Officer - Field Work job profile for the following requirements.

Can 12th Pass Freshers Apply?

Yes. The Customer Service Officer advertisement explicitly permits freshers with completed PUC or 10+2 qualifications to apply. Previous experience is preferred but is not stated as compulsory.

Preferred Work Experience

NABFINS gives preference to candidates with one to three years of experience in a similar role involving field operations and interaction with the target customer population.

Freshers who satisfy the mandatory qualifications may also apply for the position.

NABFINS Customer Service Officer Job Responsibilities

The CSO's primary responsibility is to acquire customers, expand the branch's sustainable business portfolio and manage field-level customer relationships.

  • Identify potential new business locations.
  • Source and add eligible prospective customers.
  • Support sustainable growth of the branch customer portfolio.
  • Carry out field operations involving the target customer population.
  • Collect loan instalments from customers on scheduled dates after disbursement.

Job Nature: This is a field-work position requiring customer visits, sourcing and scheduled collection activities. It should not be confused with a purely office-based customer service or data-entry role.

NABFINS Recruitment 2026 Salary

Applicants should check the individual job description and confirm the applicable remuneration and employment terms through NABFINS's official recruitment process.

NABFINS Recruitment 2026 Selection Process

The supplied careers pages do not specify a common examination, interview or written-test pattern.

NABFINS states that its decision regarding candidate eligibility, verification stages, required selection documents and other recruitment matters will be final.

Candidates should follow instructions communicated by NABFINS for the position to which they apply.

  4. Check the qualification, experience, location and other requirements.
  5. Select Apply and follow the instructions provided for that position.
  6. For the Customer Service Officer position, interested applicants can send their resume to [email protected], as stated in the job profile.
  7. Include accurate contact information and relevant educational and experience details in the resume.
  8. Complete the application before the relevant closing date.

  • Recruitment-related communication should be verified through official NABFINS channels.
  • Candidates should avoid unauthorized agents and fraudulent employment offers.
  • Any person demanding money in exchange for an NABFINS offer letter may be reported to [email protected].

South Indian Bank Junior Officer Recruitment 2026: South Indian Bank Limited has invited online applications for the post of Junior Officer (Operations). Candidates with a bachelor's degree securing at least 50% marks and a minimum of two years of experience in banks or NBFCs can apply online from 16 October to 27 October 2026. The position is initially contractual for three years, with an annual CTC of Rs. 5.14 lakh. Applications are invited from eligible candidates domiciled in Tamil Nadu, Puducherry, Maharashtra or Goa.

South Indian Bank Junior Officer Recruitment 2026 Overview

Recruiting Organization South Indian Bank Limited
Post Name Junior Officer (Operations)
Qualification Graduation in any discipline with minimum 50% marks through regular stream
Experience Minimum 2 Years in Banks or NBFCs
Age Limit Maximum 28 Years as of 30 September 2026
Age Relaxation 5 Years for SC/ST Candidates
Annual CTC Rs. 5.14 Lakh, including specified contributions and variable pay
Employment Type Contractual
Contract Duration Initially 3 Years, renewable at the Bank's discretion
Selection Process Group Discussion and/or Personal Interview
Eligible Domicile Tamil Nadu, Puducherry, Maharashtra and Goa
Application Mode Online
Application Start Date 16 October 2026
Application Last Date 27 October 2026
Official Application Portal recruit.southindianbank.com/RDC/
Official Website www.southindianbank.bank.in

Important Eligibility Notice: Only candidates domiciled in Tamil Nadu, Puducherry, Maharashtra or Goa are eligible to apply. Applicants must have completed SSLC/SSC, HSC and graduation through the regular stream (10+2+3), possess at least 50% marks in graduation and have a minimum of two years of experience in banks or NBFCs.

Event Date

Note: The application portal is directly specified in the official notification. Candidates should use the official recruitment portal and avoid unauthorized websites or recruitment agents. A separate direct notification PDF URL is not included because it has not been verified.

South Indian Bank Junior Officer Eligibility Criteria 2026

Educational Qualification

Candidates must possess a graduation degree in any discipline with a minimum of 50% marks. The prescribed educational progression is SSLC/SSC, HSC and graduation under the regular stream (10+2+3).

Work Experience

Applicants must have at least two years of experience in banks or Non-Banking Financial Companies (NBFCs) as of the eligibility cut-off date, 30 September 2026.

Domicile Eligibility

Only candidates domiciled in the following states or Union Territory are eligible:

  • Tamil Nadu
  • Puducherry
  • Maharashtra
  • Goa

The Bank will give preference to candidates proficient in the local language. Candidates must also be willing to serve anywhere in India if transferred by the Bank.

South Indian Bank Junior Officer Age Limit 2026

The maximum age limit is 28 years as of 30 September 2026. Candidates must have been born on or after 1 October 1998, subject to the prescribed relaxation.

Category Maximum Age
General and Other Categories 28 Years
SC/ST 33 Years (including 5 years of relaxation)

Candidates claiming SC/ST age relaxation must provide a valid certificate issued by the competent authority when required.

South Indian Bank Junior Officer Salary 2026

South Indian Bank has specified a total annual Cost to Company (CTC) of Rs. 5.14 lakh for Junior Officer (Operations). The CTC includes NPS contribution, insurance premium and variable pay based on performance.

Compensation / Benefit Details
Annual CTC Rs. 5.14 Lakh
Group Personal Accident Insurance Rs. 40 Lakh coverage, arranged at Bank's cost
Health Insurance Rs. 5.25 Lakh coverage, arranged at Bank's cost
Life Insurance Rs. 35 Lakh coverage; monthly premium of Rs. 214.85 inclusive of GST borne by employee, subject to revision
Annual Increment Based on performance evaluation or other parameters decided by the Bank
Official Duty Allowances Eligible lodging, halting and travelling expenses as per Bank norms

Salary Clarification: The annual CTC is not the same as take-home salary. The notification does not provide a fixed monthly in-hand salary. Other benefits applicable to the Bank's regular employees, including regular-employee staff loans and perquisites, are not applicable to this contractual appointment.

South Indian Bank Junior Officer Job Location 2026

The recruitment is being conducted for selected locations in Tamil Nadu, Puducherry, Maharashtra and Goa. Candidates can apply for one location from the notified options.

State / UT Notified Districts / Locations
Tamil Nadu Chennai, Coimbatore, Cuddalore, Dharmapuri, Erode, Karur, Nilgiris, Salem, Tiruppur, Tirunelveli, Vellore, Virudhunagar, Kancheepuram, Kanyakumari, Nagapattinam, Pudukottai, Theni, Thiruvallur, Thoothukudi and Ramanathapuram
Puducherry Puducherry
Maharashtra Aurangabad, Nagpur, Pune, Thane and Mumbai Suburban
Goa Goa

Transfer Condition: Although candidates apply for a selected location, the Bank reserves the right to transfer appointed employees anywhere in India.

South Indian Bank Junior Officer Contract Period and Career Progression

The Junior Officer (Operations) appointment is initially on a three-year contract, renewable at the sole discretion of the Bank based on performance evaluation.

After completing the initial contract or any extension, high-performing employees may be considered for regular employment as Assistant Manager (Scale I), subject to prevailing Bank norms. This is discretionary and is not a guaranteed promotion or conversion to permanent employment.

The notification also states that the mandatory minimum service agreement applicable to regularly recruited staff does not apply to this contractual position.

South Indian Bank Junior Officer Selection Process 2026

Selection will involve Group Discussion and/or Personal Interview. The Bank may modify the selection process depending on the number of applications received.

  1. Shortlisting of eligible applicants
  2. Group Discussion and/or Personal Interview
  3. Verification of original documents and eligibility
  4. Medical fitness and background verification, including credit history, CFR and police clearance checks
  5. Final appointment subject to Bank requirements

Meeting the minimum eligibility criteria does not guarantee a call for the recruitment process. All selection-related communications will be sent through official channels, including the applicant's registered email address.

How to Apply for South Indian Bank Junior Officer Recruitment 2026

  1. Visit the official application portal at recruit.southindianbank.com/RDC/.
  2. Read the Junior Officer (Operations) recruitment notification and verify the eligibility requirements.
  3. Open the online application for the Junior Officer (Operations) position.
  4. Enter the required personal, contact, educational qualification and work experience details.
  5. Select the preferred notified location as permitted by the application form.
  6. Upload the prescribed photograph, signature and resume.
  7. Review the application carefully before submission.
  8. Submit the application online by 27 October 2026.
  9. Save the system-generated User ID or Application Reference ID.
  10. Check the registered email for application details, login credentials and the application PDF.
  11. Log in to verify that the application status shows successful submission.

Important: The Bank does not permit modification of submitted applications. Multiple registrations for the same role will result in disqualification. Candidates do not need to send a physical copy of the application to the Bank.

Photograph, Signature and Resume Upload Requirements

Document Specifications
Photograph Recent passport-size colour photograph with white background; 378 x 437 pixels; maximum 50 KB
Signature Signature using black ink on white paper; 140 x 110 pixels; maximum 50 KB
Resume PDF format; maximum 1 MB

Photographs with caps, hats or dark glasses will not be accepted. Applicants should retain two copies of the same photograph for use during the recruitment process.

South Indian Bank Junior Officer Recruitment 2026 Important Instructions

  • Applications are accepted only through the official online recruitment portal.
  • Candidates must possess a valid personal email address and accessible contact number.
  • Only candidates domiciled in the specified states or Union Territory are eligible.
  • The required educational qualification and experience must be satisfied as of 30 September 2026.
  • Applicants must be willing to serve anywhere in India.
  • Selection and appointment are subject to original document verification and background checks.
  • No modifications are allowed after final application submission.
  • All subsequent recruitment updates and corrigenda will be published through official Bank channels.

  • Job location: Not specified in the indicative notice.

The notice carries the following notes for candidates:

  5. Submit the complete online application between the tentative opening date (05.11.2026) and closing date (04.12.2026, 23:59 hours).
